# Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist

VSS International, Inc.

[West Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/West-Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7667651476294628851?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7914&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8760796049469265019&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist

We are growing and in need of a Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist for our VSS International, Inc. facility.

Come join a team with a great company culture that offers competitive wages and benefits!! We offer Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision Care Insurance. We offer a 401k program. A Pension Program, Life Insurance, AD&D and opportunities for growth and development

The Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for managing the organization's accounts receivable process to ensure timely and accurate collection of payments, and to assist Corporate Credit Manager in additional tasks when asked. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong analytical skills to maintain financial records, resolve billing discrepancies, and communicate effectively with clients.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Monitor accounts receivable for assigned companies with focus on aging balances, customer comments, and follow-up activity.
- Contact customers regarding past due balances, obtain payment status updates, and help resolve billing, cash posting, credit and rebill, refund, and adjustment issues.
- Prepare and process daily bank deposits, cash posting batches, credit card payment batches, trade and miscellaneous deposits, and related bank logs.
- Maintain accurate AR records in Vista and related reports, aging spreadsheets, cash posting logs, invoice logs, billing reports, and virtual reports.
- Process monthly statements, approved write-offs, finance charge adjustments, warranty adjustments, intercompany billings, back charges, progress billings, and subcontractor vouchers.
- Support month-end close activities for cash and accounts receivable, including balancing cash posting logs, clearing accounts, and applicable AR close reports.
- Maintain UPS-related billing reports, invoice logs, virtual reports, job number issuance, job announcements, and MLBS tracking for all locations.
- Monitor NACM communications and coordinate with the Corporate Credit Manager on issues requiring review, approval, or follow-up.
- Serve as backup support for other companies aging reports, the Invoice Specialist, trade and miscellaneous deposits, and other assigned AR functions as needed.
- Assist the Modesto team with AR-related questions or issues and coordinate with IT on COMMAND, Vista, APEX, or other system-related issues for assigned companies.
- Complete additional projects, reporting, administrative tasks, and assigned AR functions as trained and directed by the Corporate Credit Manager.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience with Vista by Viewpoint accounting software preferred.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word; 10-key by touch preferred.
- Strong knowledge of accounts receivable processes, basic accounting principles, billing, cash application, credit, and collections practices.
- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and manage multiple tasks accurately.
- High attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing financial information, customer accounts, reports, and supporting documentation.
- Strong problem-solving, research, documentation, and reconciliation skills.
- Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with customers, vendors, team members, managers, and other departments.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive customer, credit, and financial information.
- Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently or collaboratively in a team environment.
- Ability to follow established procedures, maintain organized records, and support process consistency.
- 2+ years of accounts receivable/ accounting experience
- High school diploma required, college courses in accounting preferred

AFFIRMATIVE ACTION STATEMENT:

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, resourceful, and capable of managing multiple priorities while coordinating information, schedules, documents, and tasks across different teams.

##### Responsibilities

- Coordinate daily administrative activities and support business operations.
- Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and schedules.
- Coordinate communication and information between internal teams and external contacts.
- Organize and maintain digital files, documents, records, and databases.
- Prepare, update, and distribute reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and other documents.
- Monitor administrative tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups to ensure timely completion.
- Assist with onboarding, team coordination, and other internal administrative processes.
- Manage routine emails, requests, and inquiries and ensure they are directed to the appropriate person or team.

- Maintain accurate records and ensure information is properly documented and organized.

- Strong organizational and coordination abilities.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong time-management and prioritization skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
- Comfortable using calendars, spreadsheets, project management tools, and digital communication platforms.
- Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders.
- Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt to changing priorities.
- Professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.

- Experience coordinating schedules, meetings, documents, and administrative processes.
- Strong computer and digital skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with remote teams.
- Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.

### Job Description

Job Description

Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking a **Senior Scheduler** for a confidential hyperscale data center client, both setting the standard other reviewers work to and carrying a portfolio of independent schedule reviews yourself. You will test whether developer-provided delivery dates are realistic, and you will decide what a rigorous review looks like for everyone doing that work alongside you.

**Responsibilities**

- **Schedule review:** Assess developer construction schedules from the ground up: logic, critical path and near-critical activity credibility, float, and sequencing. Confirm whether the delivery date, power connection, and commissioning and testing timelines are actually realistic, against the client's and our team's benchmarks.
- **Supply chain and resourcing:** Review the equipment and staffing plan behind a schedule, including long lead equipment orders and resource loading, and confirm whether the labor and materials backing the dates are firm commitments or assumptions.
- **Evidence discipline:** Be precise about what is known versus what is assumed. State plainly whether a number or date is confirmed, estimated, or simply what the developer has claimed, and hold your team to the same standard.
- **Risk identification:** Flag the risks a clean-looking schedule hides: long lead equipment, permitting, utility connections, seasonal weather, and compressed commissioning windows.
- **Trend and variance analysis:** Track how each schedule moves from one review to the next, not just a single point-in-time snapshot, and flag material variances and their likely cause.
- **Acceleration analysis:** Where a date is at risk, assess what could actually recover time, and which options are real versus cosmetic.
- **Delivery handover:** At construction start, make sure a clear schedule record, what was confirmed, what was assumed, and what is still an open risk, is handed to the onsite construction team on every deal your team touches.
- **Setting the standard:** Define what a complete, defensible schedule review looks like: the checklist, the depth of testing, and the level of evidence required, and hold every review on the team to it.
- **Quality control:** Review your team's higher-stakes findings before they reach a client, catching gaps or unsupported claims before anyone else does.
- **Benchmarking:** Build and maintain the library of schedule benchmarks, typical durations for long lead equipment, permitting, energization, and commissioning, that the whole team reviews against, so judgment calls are grounded in real data rather than memory.
- **Process improvement:** Build and refine the templates, tools, and checklists the schedule discipline runs on as the portfolio and the team grow.

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Qualifications

- 10 plus years of planning and scheduling experience, data center or other mission-critical facility delivery strongly preferred.
- **Preferably located in/near San Francisco, CA or Northern VA but will consider remote candidates as well as long as they are able to travel occasionally for site visits and team collaboration.**
- Working fluency in P6 or equivalent scheduling software, including logic, critical path, and float credibility.
- Familiarity with earned value management (EVM) or similar progress-measurement methods, to independently sanity-check a developer's reported percent complete against actual schedule progress.
- Practical knowledge of long lead equipment timelines, utility and energization sequencing, permitting, and commissioning and testing durations in complex facility construction.
- Understanding of acceleration levers in data center construction, and the judgment to tell a real one from a cosmetic one.
- Comfortable delivering a difficult finding to a developer directly, professionally, and on a deadline, and comfortable holding a colleague's work to that same standard.
- Able to work from incomplete or dated information and state the caveats plainly, rather than waiting for a perfect dataset.
- Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent projects, and across a team's workload, not just your own.
- Strong written communication. Findings need to be usable by people who were not in the review, and feed directly into the client-facing due diligence report.
- AACE PSP or PMI-SP certification is a plus, not required.
- Technologically proficient, including MS Suite and Google Workspace in addition to scheduling software.

**Project/Program Specifications**

- **Market sector experience:** Data center development, mission critical facilities, or complex technical and hyperscale buildings strongly preferred.
- **Software specific requirements:** P6 or equivalent scheduling software, MS Suite, and Google Workspace.
- **Travel:** Minimal, approximately 3 days per month, plus occasional site visits and team collaboration.

# Senior Accounts Receivable Specialist

$75k - $95k

Botrista

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3595005482087944779?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=690&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2101111345748919278&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

About Us

At Botrista, we are transforming beverage culture with intuitive drink-making technology guided by Nature herself. By allowing restaurants to easily expand menus without added complexity, we’re driving incremental growth with the push of a button.

Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our beverage solution has created a new industry category, universally applicable to any cuisine, demographic and business. Our machines are being rapidly deployed around the country for customers to experience & enjoy.

We deliver a world of flavors at your fingertips by sourcing top-tier ingredients, accessories, & toppings from around the globe. Thanks to valuable data collected through our integrated CloudBar system, we easily guide our partners through their drink menu innovation.

Each drink is crafted by nature, and perfected by innovation - we’d love to have you be a part of it.

Summary

We are seeking a versatile and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our US Finance team. Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, this role is responsible for supporting day-to-day AR operations, credit risk monitoring, cash management, and cross-border accounting coordination. The ideal candidate will thrive in a dynamic environment, demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, and be adaptable to evolving operational priorities.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Credit & Collections Management

- Monitor customer account balances, aging reports, and credit risks.

- Partner with cross-functional teams (Sales, Account Management, Customer Success) to address payment delinquencies, structure payment arrangements, and resolve customer inquiries.
- Assist in evaluating customer credit profiles and implementing necessary risk mitigation controls (e.g., credit holds or account adjustments).

2\. Cash Application & Operations Lead

- Manage daily cash applications, payment matching, fee reconciliations, and local check deposits per financial controls.
- Investigate payment discrepancies while administering the US AR mailbox during local business hours as the primary contact for customer and internal requests.

3\. Financial Reconciliations & Close Assistance

- Assist with month-end close procedures, including AR reserve analysis, sales tax reconciliations, and account balance reviews.
- Prepare routine accounting entries, schedules, and reconciliations for receivables and associated accounts. Ensure accuracy of financial data and compliance with internal accounting policies.

4\. Cross-Border & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with regional/global accounting teams to ensure seamless operational continuity across time zones.
- Process routine requests, invoice adjustments, and credit memos in coordination with logistics and operations teams. Manage shared department communication channels to ensure timely response to internal and external stakeholders.

5\. Operational Flexibility & Special Projects

- Perform other accounting, administrative, or analytical duties as assigned to support business growth and changing operational needs.
- Participate in process improvement initiatives, system updates, and workflow enhancements as requested by management.

**Requirements**

- Work Arrangement: Ability to work in-office or hybrid as determined by company policy.
- Experience: 5+ years of progressive Accounts Receivable, Credit/Collections, or general accounting experience.
- System Aptitude: Proficiency with mainstream ERP platforms (NetSuite or similar) and payment management portals (Versapay or similar).
- Skills: Solid understanding of general accounting principles, financial reconciliations, and basic US sales tax concepts.
- Communication & Negotiation: Strong written and verbal communication skills with a firm, professional, and solution-oriented approach.
- Adaptability: High degree of flexibility and capacity to reprioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- Physical Requirement: Ability to manage weekly local banking tasks and document handling as required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.
- Language: Professional working proficiency or conversational skills in Mandarin Chinese is a strong plus (for cross-border collaboration with the Taiwan accounting team).

**Benefits**

- Fully company-paid Medical and 99% company-paid Dental and Vision Insurance

- 15 days Paid Time Off, 7 sick days, 14 holidays, Wellness Benefits, Cell Phone and Internet reimbursement, 401K

- Beautiful new SF office with outdoor rooftop workspace

- Free beverages with our DrinkBot Pro, snacks, and free lunches on Monday and Wednesdays.

**$75,000 - $95,000**

**Plus bonus and stock options**

# Senior Scheduler Utilities

Terravanta Inc

[Rosemead, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Rosemead%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3815415244372679830?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6607&pageType=7&jobAge=210&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6948274229792383038&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- Opportunity for advancement
- Paid time off
- Training & development
- Competitive salary

**Location (two positions) – Rosemead and Pomona, CA**

**Utilities (Electric Infrastructure)**

**About us:**

Terravanta is a certified woman- and minority-owned business providing project management, engineering, and sustainable solutions across the energy, transportation, aviation, and education sectors. We are committed to quality, excellence, and proactive problem-solving, helping clients achieve successful outcomes at every stage of project delivery.

At Terravanta, we value our people, foster a collaborative and inclusive culture, and provide opportunities to make a meaningful impact. Guided by our commitment to environmental stewardship, sustainability, and responsible business practices, we create lasting value for both our clients and the communities we serve. Through community engagement, partnerships, and service, we strive to make a positive difference beyond our projects. At Terravanta, you'll be part of a purpose-driven team dedicated to excellence, innovation, and building stronger, more sustainable communities.

**About the role:**

The Senior Scheduler supports project and program management by developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules, tracking progress, and delivering data-driven insights to guide strategic decision-making. This role integrates scheduling with cost controls, risk analysis, and performance reporting while leveraging both traditional methodologies and emerging technologies (including AI-driven analytics) to improve forecasting, data quality, and process optimization.

This position has a strong emphasis on **electric utilities** , including **generation and interconnection facilities** , with experience in **hydroelectric and gas generation , substation, transmission and distribution projects** . The role supports the mission to power the planet sustainably and reduce carbon emissions.

The candidate

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop, maintain, and manage **integrated master schedules** for major capital projects and large-scale distribution programs (30+ work groups), including tracking permitting and regulatory milestones.
- Lead **schedule development, tracking, monitoring, and reporting** to ensure projects are delivered on time across multi-year programs.
- Integrate existing schedules (owners, contractors, vendors) into a **comprehensive, resource-loaded master schedule** .
- Incorporate contractor schedules into owner schedules and ensure alignment across all project stakeholders.
- Perform **critical path analysis** , identify schedule risks, and proactively recommend mitigation strategies.
- Conduct **time impact analysis (TIA)** and document delays with clear supporting data.
- Convert and align **Excel-based schedules into Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project** environments.
- Perform **resource loading and forecasting** , ensuring accurate staffing and execution planning.
- Support scheduling for **electric utility infrastructure projects** , **substation, transmission, distribution** , including **generation (hydro, gas)** and **interconnection facilities** .
- Perform complex research, updates, and data analysis related to scheduling and project controls.
- Prepare and present results, alternatives, and recommendations to support decision-making, cost management, and risk mitigation.
- Support regulatory and governance requirements, including data requests for audits, rate cases, and filings.
- Apply **earned value management (EVM)** principles, including WBS development, schedule performance tracking, and variance analysis.
- Collaborate with project teams to define objectives, milestones, deliverables, and execution strategies.
- Identify trends and assess performance against baseline schedules.
- Drive issue resolution proactively or escalate to Project Managers as needed.
- Mentor and support the development of junior scheduling and project controls professionals.
- Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, including field personnel and contractors.
- Travel to job sites as needed (generally less than once per month).
- Stay adept with technology, and industry standards. Attend industry forums and participate in developing future trainings/courses as necessary.

**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Finance, or equivalent experience.
- **10+ years of experience** in scheduling for capital projects and/or construction.
- Strong experience in **electric utilities** , with emphasis on:
- Generation (hydroelectric and gas plants
- Transmission/interconnection facilities
- Proven ability to:
- Convert Excel schedules into **Primavera P6 / Microsoft Project**
- Develop and manage **resource-loaded schedules**
- Perform **critical path analysis**
- Integrate **contractor schedules into master owner schedules**
- Experience with **Primavera P6 (required)** and Microsoft Project.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio) and SAP.
- Experience in **project controls, construction, or infrastructure projects** (strongly preferred).

**Certifications (Preferred)**

- Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP)
- Earned Value Professional (EVP)
- Certified Cost Professional (CCP)
- Project Management Professional (PMP)

**Software**

- Primavera P6
- Microsoft Project
- Microsoft Excel (advanced scheduling applications)

**Core Skills**

- Strong communication and stakeholder coordination
- Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
- Critical thinking and analytical capability
- Strong judgment and decision-making skills
- Adaptability in dynamic project environments
- High attention to detail and organizational skills

# Sr. Marketing Manager

Location:New YorkCompany:BeSound

## Description:

**Company Description**

BeSound is focused on modernizing breast care with advanced technology designed to detect what traditional mammograms can miss. The organization is committed to improving early detection and diagnostic accuracy, helping clinicians and patients make more informed decisions. BeSound works at the intersection of medical innovation and patient-centered care, striving to close gaps in current screening methods. Team members join a mission-driven environment where their work directly contributes to better health outcomes and greater peace of mind for those at risk. To learn more about BeSound, visit: www.besoundbreast.com

**The Role:**

BeSound is seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Marketing Manager to drive the growth and engagement of our community through innovative marketing programs. Reporting to the Head of Marketing and collaborating closely with our Clinical and Product teams, you will work cross-functionally and with external partners to implement high-impact organic and paid campaigns that increase awareness, acquisition, and retention. This role is a blend of strategic planning and hands-on execution, perfect for a creative and analytical marketer passionate about making a meaningful impact in the health and wellness space.

**Who you are:**

You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about taking a defining role at an early-stage startup. You’re both creative and analytical and enjoy solving complex problems. You’re comfortable with change, and ready to pivot in response to customer and client feedback and needs.

You have a strong base of knowledge in acquisition and growth marketing from 4-6 years at a DTC consumer brand. You’ve scheduled and sent / posted hundreds of brand emails and social posts and know your way around Google Analytics. You’re looking to work in a high-growth, venture capital backed business with great mentors and teachers.

**Required skills / experiences:**

- Hands-on experience managing organic growth in-house for a full funnel DTC business including email campaigns, organic social, partnerships, and influencer. Prior experience with local marketing is a plus.
- Proficiency in analyzing campaign data, identifying trends, and leveraging insights to refine marketing strategies and optimize ROI.
- Proven experience managing CRM platforms like Iterable (or similar) to drive acquisition and retention through advanced client segmentation, in-depth retention flows, and data-driven lifecycle campaigns. Skilled at creating personalized, automated workflows that enhance customer engagement and maximize LTV.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to drive both creative and technical aspects
- Familiarity with digital marketing KPIs such as CPA, CPC, CPM, LTV and ROAS
- Ability to work independently, meeting deadlines with a positive attitude and eagerness to learn
- Excellent written and verbal communication ability
- Experience in health and wellness is a plus and passion for what we do is a must. Experience with physical locations is helpful.

**Responsibilities:**

- Contribute to organic strategy in partnership with the Head of Marketing.
- Own execution and project management of all organic marketing programs including email, organic social, referral, influencer, partnerships, and events
- Track paid and organic marketing campaign performance in tandem with our agency partners while synthesizing clear and concise learnings to create a compelling brand and product narrative
- Work with Head of Marketing and creative partners to ideate innovative campaigns which drive acquisition and define a new category within healthcare / wellness
- Lead project management of all creative asset production; partner with internal, agency and freelance team members to generate engaging, on brand content quickly and within budget
- Think strategically, creatively and analytically to identify new demand generation programs
- Shape the long-term marketing roadmap, identifying opportunities to define BeSound as a thought leader in wellness and healthcare innovation

# General Accountant (Staff Accountant / Bookkeeper) (Indianapolis)

Location:West Indianapolis, INCompany:J.R. Helms & Associates, P.C.

## Description:

**General Accountant (Staff Accountant / Bookkeeper)**

Indianapolis, IN \| Full-Time \| On-site

**About the Role**

**J.R. Helms & Associates, P.C.** is a full-service accounting, tax, and business consulting firm based in Indianapolis. We’re hiring a **Staff Accountant / General Accountant** who wants meaningful client work, professional growth, and a clear development path.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on accounting and bookkeeping experience who is ready to take ownership of general ledger responsibilities while continuing to grow in a supportive, collaborative public accounting environment.

_This role requires sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think through issues—not just follow a checklist._

**What You’ll Do**

- Prepare and post **journal entries**
- Reconcile and maintain **general ledger accounts**
- Support **month-end and year-end close**
- Prepare **financial statements** and supporting schedules
- Research and resolve **account discrepancies**
- Perform and support **month-end** and **year-end close activities**
- Perform **data entry and financial analysis**
- Support **income tax preparation** for individual, business, and non-profit clients (as assigned)
- Communicate clearly with clients and internal team members

**What We’re Looking For**

- Experience with **QuickBooks** and general ledger accounting
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to analyze issues and problem-solve independently
- Clear, professional communication skills
- Comfort working with multiple clients or entities
- Public accounting or small-business accounting experience preferred

**Why J.R. Helms & Associates?**

At J.R. Helms & Associates, you won't be limited to one narrow accounting function. You'll work with multiple small-business clients, see how their day-to-day accounting activity flows through the general ledger and financial statements, and help solve the real accounting issues that come with running a business. We're a growing local firm where accountants have the opportunity to build broad practical experience, take ownership of their work, and work directly with clients and firm leadership.

We value:

- **Meaningful client relationships** — Work directly with small-business owners and understand the businesses behind the numbers.
- **Broad accounting experience** — Work across general ledger accounting, reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, cleanup work, and other client needs.
- **Variety in your work** — Gain experience with multiple clients, industries, entities, and accounting situations rather than one company's books.
- **Professional independence** — As your experience grows, you'll be trusted to manage your work, investigate issues, and follow problems through to resolution.
- **Accessible leadership** — Work closely with firm leadership and experienced accountants rather than through multiple layers of management.
- **Continued growth** — Build deeper accounting knowledge and take on greater responsibility as your skills develop.
- **A small-firm environment** — Your work, ideas, and contributions are visible and have a direct impact on the firm and our clients.
- **Long-term opportunity** — Join a growing firm looking for accounting professionals who want to develop with us.

**Compensation: $44,500–$81,000** **annually**, _based on relevant accounting experience_, level of independence, technical capability, and overall fit for the role.

**You May Be a Great Fit If**

- You enjoy hands-on accounting work and are comfortable working directly in the general ledger
- You have experience with journal entries, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial statements
- You like figuring out why an account doesn't reconcile or why the numbers don't look right
- You can work through accounting issues independently while knowing when to ask questions
- You enjoy working with multiple businesses or entities rather than focusing on only one company's accounting
- You're comfortable using QuickBooks and learning different client systems and processes
- You communicate professionally with clients and are comfortable requesting information and following up when something is missing
- You value accuracy, reliability, accountability, and taking ownership of your work
- You enjoy the variety and adaptability that comes with working in a smaller professional firm
- You're looking for an opportunity to continue developing your accounting skills and take on greater responsibility over time

- Monitor competitor activity and market trends, providing insight to sales and leadership teams.
- Lead marketing support for strategic partners and co-marketing initiatives.

- Act as the key marketing voice for the US region within the global organisation.

- Strong stakeholder management and project management skills.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

# Administrative Specialist III

Location:Pasadena, CACompany:Kaiser Permanente

## Description:

Job Summary: Independently plans and executes information maintenance and distribution by drafting standard and nonstandard presentations, detailed correspondence, and reports. Executes workflow independently by assisting in the novel resolution of standard and nonstandard requests from department managers on an ad-hoc basis. Contributes to event coordination by beginning to develop relationships with leaders assistants and an understanding of organizational hierarchy when coordinating and calendaring meetings for directors and their direct teams, independently. Contributes to event execution by assisting senior colleagues to gather materials, plan, and arrange medium-scale events. Enacts data maintenance and management by integrating department data and documentation retention policies into all products. Essential Responsibilities: + Pursues effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome. + Completes work assignments autonomously by applying up-to-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensures all procedures and policies are followed; leverages an understanding of data and resources to support projects or initiatives. Collaborates cross-functionally to solve business problems; escalates issues or risks as appropriate; communicates progress and information. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team. + Independently plans and executes information dissemination by: drafting standard and nonstandard presentations, handouts, reports/spreadsheets, graphics, status reports, resource management reports, and other deliverables with regular review from senior colleagues; writing detailed correspondence (e.g., letters, reports, confidential documents) to staff, managers, and external members/providers, with review from team or manager; labeling, sorting, and maintaining the integrity of department files, independently; and utilizing a variety of software and databases to retrieve required information to write detailed reports. + Executes the work flow of the department independently by: assisting in the novel resolution of standard and nonstandard requests from department managers on an ad-hoc basis; independently anticipating and offering assistance for business needs (e.g., manager email requests) that require support; operating standard office equipment (e.g., email, fax, xerox); beginning to maintain databases and websites, with review from senior colleagues/managers; maintaining inventory control, stocking, and providing solutions for department office inventory, equipment, and employee work environment resources (e.g., space assignment, computer) in alignment with budgetary policies and escalating inventory issues; receiving, screening, and referring nonstandard and standard incoming and outgoing emails, calls, and visits to the appropriate staff member; investigate time card issues and provide recommendations to management; learning about new staffing onboarding activities and assisting in execution, when necessary; and leveraging the HR information system to maintain knowledge of the contract language, standard/nonstandard pay practices (e.g., travel, shift differentials), and changes to job functions, job descriptions, and role goals, consulting senior colleagues or managers as needed. + Contributes to event coordination by: beginning to develop relationships with leaders assistants and an understanding of organizational hierarchy to leverage when coordinating, calendaring, and facilitating meetings for directors and their direct teams with front line employees, independently; may be independently planning for meeting facilitation through PowerPoint presentation coordination, taking parking lot notes, ensuring equipment works, and ordering food when appropriate; finding and booking meeting standard and nonstandard rooms appropriate for the audience and meeting objectives, with general oversight. + Contributes to event execution by: assisting senior colleagues to gather materials, plan, and arrange medium-scale events; organizing standard and nonstandard travel arrangements large, complex events for department head and/or multiple managers; assisting in execution of medium group meetings, conferences; providing on-site coordination for nonstandard and standard issues; independently plans coordination and execution of audio-visual equipment, conference rooms, and catering for events, with review by team or manager; and distributing the agenda, taking meeting minutes, summarizing and finalizing meeting summaries, and coordinating guest presentations in department meetings. + Enacts human-resources data maintenance and management by: integrating department data and documentation retention policies into all products; inputting, compiling, organizing, validating, tracking, and maintaining data integrity for standard databases; and formatting straightforward graphs, spreadsheets, and reports. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: (Core) + Ambiguity/Uncertainty Management + Attention to Detail + Business Knowledge + Communication + Critical Thinking + Cross-Group Collaboration + Decision Making + Dependability + Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Support + Drives Results + Facilitation Skills + Health Care Industry + Influencing Others + Integrity + Learning Agility + Organizational Savvy + Problem Solving + Short- and Long-term Learning & Recall + Teamwork + Topic-Specific Communication Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: (Functional) + Computer Literacy + Customer Experience + Data Entry + Data Integrity + Interpersonal Skills Minimum Qualifications: + High School Diploma or GED, or equivalent AND two (2) years of experience in administrative support or related field, OR Minimum three (3) years of experience in administrative support or related field. Preferred Qualifications: + One (1) year of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above). + One (1) year of experience developing and delivering presentations to management. COMPANY: KAISER TITLE: Administrative Specialist III LOCATION: Pasadena, California REQNUMBER: 1453940 External hires must pass a background check/drug screen. Qualified applicants with arrest and/or conviction records will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with Federal, state and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran, or disability status.

Human Resources Coordinator III Job Schedule: Candidate needs to be local and able to go into the office as needed 3-5 days a week (primarily Tues/Wed/Thurs). There could be events where they are over the course of multiple days and hours where they might need come in earlier or stay later. Work schedule will be primarily 37.5 hours/week however if there are events the work hours could go over 37.5 hours/week. The Human Resources Coordinator is responsible for providing general administrative level support in managing the day-to-day operations of various Human Resources (HR) initiatives and projects with a local and global footprint. The HR Coordinator will assist with a variety of HR-related tasks and activities in support of functional programs, processes, and services. This could include scheduling and arranging meetings, logistics, invitations, document preparation, file management, ordering supplies, managing purchase orders, and maintaining records, etc. They must have an excellent understanding of how to manage their tasks with strict deadlines while staying within budget constraints by effectively utilizing resources. Responsibilities - Provide general coordination support across HR Centers of Excellence (CoE). - Project coordination support for various HR initiatives, projects, and related activities. Examples include but are not limited to, Take Your Children to Work Day, Benefits, Inclusion & Diversity, Learning & Development, and HR events as well as Talent Acquisition activities, etc. - Schedule and organize meetings and events (in-person, virtual and hybrid). - Manage calendars, registrations, invitations, shared mailboxes, etc. - General program and event planning support. Responsible for logistics, which may include scheduling, calendar invitations, reserving meeting space and catering, room set up and technology (A/V), printing, ordering materials and supplies, and coordinating participants, guest access and facilitators, etc. - Update and maintain documentation and files as needed, including presentation handouts, job aids, manuals, etc., as well as proofing, editing, and copying. - Manage purchase orders and accruals; track expenditures as needed. - Maintain accurate records and create reports. Develop and maintain various distribution lists and spreadsheets. - Liaise with vendors. Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders. - Seek opportunities to increase efficiency and process improvements where applicable. - Organize, coordinate, and follow up on special projects as assigned. Experience Qualifications - Completed Bachelor's Degree Required - 1 or More Years Related work experience required. - Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint required. - Experience in a Human Resources environment preferred. - Experience working with senior leaders, management, and internal and external stakeholders preferred. # Administrative Coordinator

$24.28 - $30.36 per hour

MedAmerica, Inc.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2013749049837865410?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2132416236228855166&crId=US_0US_0)

**Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Administrative Coordinator**

**Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare**

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

**Join the Vituity Team.** At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

**Vituity Locations:** Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

**The Opportunity**

- Communicate any messages/inquiries/issues effectively, in a timely manner and professionally by showing sensitivity and respecting confidentiality. This includes both written and verbal communications with internal and external clients.
- Complete a broad variety of administrative tasks in support of the assigned department including managing an active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel relative meetings.
- Prepare professional reports and presentations as directed.
- Manage daily administrative duties with an emphasis on enhancing efficient workflow.
- Assist leadership with calendar support. Responsibilities could include internal/external meeting scheduling, reviewing calendars for conflicts, accepting/declining meetings on behalf of leaders, reminders of meetings and logistics and/or materials that may be needed.
- Make travel arrangements on behalf of leadership in accordance with policy.
- Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents. File and retrieve documents and reference materials. May conduct research, assemble and analyze data to prepare reports and documents.
- May initiate follow ups for specific leadership initiatives. Responsibilities could include contract expiration, meeting action items, evaluation feedback, surveys, required education and compliance, and other related work.
- May be responsible for answering and screening phone calls in a professional manner; take messages and handle inquiries as appropriate.
- May work with department leaders to develop necessary materials (e.g., manual, training modules, curriculum, etc.) to support the program. Evaluate impact of program in meeting the defined objectives of the program.
- Coordinate staff meetings/events/conference calls as instructed by leadership. Responsibilities could include agenda preparation, presentations, staffing, meeting collateral, logistics, notes, action item follow-up as necessary, etc.
- Review operating practices and implement improvements where necessary.
- Utilize and enter data into all department databases.
- Coordinate regional department activities as directed.
- Maintain Reporting, Time and Expenses, Project Status Reports, and Budget Reports.
- Collect and analyze data to produce weekly and monthly specialized reports.
- May coordinate seminars/meetings (planning, coordination with corporate staff on mailings, hotels, pre- and post-seminar follow-up), and attend seminars/meetings as directed to assist with registration and face-to-face contact with attendees.
- If supporting the Marketing department, duties will also include:
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for requests from other departments, IT issues, HR/compliance reminders, etc.
 - Maintain the [View email address on click.appcast.io](https://jooble.org/away/2013749049837865410?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2132416236228855166&crId=US_0US_0) distribution list, responding to requests and directs to appropriate marketing resources and/or team members.
 - Regularly update and maintain essential marketing documents, content databases, and media assets.
 - Support campaign planning and execution efforts – clearly communicate campaign goals, deliverables, and timelines to the team.
- Coordinate the development of product and/or materials and other documents as needed to enable successful delivery of service to the clients/stakeholders.
- Attend project meetings and take minutes.
- Support a wide variety of special projects some of which may have organizational impact.
- May support the planning efforts associated with broader enterprise-wide meetings and events, ensuring seamless marketing operations.

**Required Experience and Competencies**

- High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
- Two (2) years of administrative or office support, administrative analyst, or project/department coordination/support role required.
- 3-4 years of increasingly complex administrative support & project coordination experience preferred.
- Previous experience supporting a Marketing team is preferred if assigned to the Marketing department preferred.
- Previous customer service experience preferred.
- Ability to work independently with drive and initiative but also work well within a teamwork setting.
- Detail oriented and organized with the ability to juggle multiple tasks, prioritizing projects effectively, and maintaining a smooth operational flow within the assigned department.
- Ability to complete tasks with varying priorities under conditions requiring speed and accuracy.
- General knowledge of administrative procedures and standard business office practices.
- Must have strong customer service with client interactions both verbally and written.
- Strong analytical skills, creative conceptualization, collaborative management ability, and oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to handle detailed work accurately and quickly, work to deadlines on multiple projects, and to work as a team member in a collaborative and participatory manner, and to interact both in person and over the phone with a courteous and professional demeanor.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to use office equipment and automated systems/applications/software at an acceptable level of proficiency.
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships as required by the duties of the position.
- Ability to read, understand and communicate in English sufficient to perform the duties of the position.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- If in the Business Development department, proficiency in content authoring tool – Captivate; if in the Learning & Development department, the ability to create e-learning courses.

**The Community**

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

- Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
- Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
- Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
- Flexible work hours
- Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

**Benefits & Beyond\***

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

- Superior health plan options
- Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
- Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6% plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
- Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
- Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
- Professional and Career Development Program
- EAP and travel assistance included
- Wellness program
- Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $24.28 - $30.36, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Must be fluent in two or more languages, including at least one language that supports the needs of the program and the community served. This position is currently based in the San Luis Obispo office and may be reassigned to the Paso Robles office based on operational needs.

The Community Action Partnership Child Care Resource Connection Office Assistant is responsible for providing general clerical and administrative support to all CCRC programs. Supports CAPSLO’s mission by ensuring timely processing of clerical and administrative tasks, needed in helping program staff to ensure prompt services to clients.

**What we're looking for in the ideal candidate:** **Level I:**

Three years of education and/or experience performing general office duties.

Proficiency in office productivity software, including Microsoft Word and Excel or comparable applications such as Google Docs and Google Sheets.

Must be fluent in two or more languages, including one that supports the needs of the program and community.

**Level II:**

Five years of education and/or experience performing general office duties.

At least six months experience working with the CAPSLO Child Care Resource Connection.

Proficiency in office productivity software, including Microsoft Word and Excel or comparable applications such as Google Docs and Google Sheets.

**All Levels:**

Depending on the department assigned, a valid California driver's license, a current DMV driving record, and proof of insurance may be required to fulfill job-related travel. For positions where driving is an essential function of the job, candidates must be at least 21 years of age and have a minimum of three (3) years of driving experience. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable laws.

**As an Office Assistant you will:**

Greet visitors, respond to inquiries, and direct individuals to the appropriate staff, department, or resource.

Answer, screen, and route incoming telephone calls in a professional and courteous manner.

Collect and record preliminary information from prospective clients and assist with routine information and referral inquiries.

Perform a variety of administrative and clerical duties, including data entry, filing, mail processing, copying, scanning, faxing, and maintaining electronic and paper records.

Assemble, prepare, distribute, and maintain program materials, forms, correspondence, and other office documents.

Maintain calendars, coordinate meetings, schedule appointments, and assist with organizing, preparing, and distributing meeting agendas and minutes.

Create and distribute informational materials such as flyers, newsletters, brochures, posters, and other resources supporting program outreach and operations.

Support program-specific administrative functions, including routine clerical tasks associated with assigned programs.

Maintain office and reception areas in a clean, organized, and welcoming condition, ensuring brochures, supplies, and forms are adequately stocked.

Process, distribute, and deliver incoming and outgoing mail, documents, packages, and correspondence, including routine interoffice deliveries.

Utilize office software, database systems, spreadsheets, and word processing applications to support daily operations.

Attend staff meetings, trainings, workshops, conferences, and other meetings as assigned.

Provide translation and interpretation services when applicable.

Follow all agency safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe environment for employees, clients, and visitors.

Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

Please note this job advertisement is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

# Ski School Admin & Scheduling Coordinator

$18.75 - $22 per hour

Dodge Ridge Corp.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6232023062694479794?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7633144795880803072&crId=US_0US_0)

Seasonal Position Dodge Ridge Ski Resort Pinecrest, CA, US
30+ days ago Requisition ID: 1562
Salary Range: $18.75 To $22.00 Hourly
Summary of Job Purpose Responsibilities of Ski/Snowboard School Admin include communicating with guests to explain lesson products and selling all Ski/Snowboard School products through the Reservation system and Guest Services.
Assisting the Ski/Snowboard School Admin . duties include identifying what instructors can appropriately teach class levels and updating instructors' schedules. Assist in various admin duties, such as scheduling, payroll, and updating boards. This is an Admin role of the Ski/Snowboard School Team.
Job Duties and Responsibilities This job description is intended as a summary of the primary responsibilities of and the qualifications for the position. The job description is not intended to be inclusive of all duties an individual in the position might be asked to perform or of all the qualifications that may be required now or in the future. We will not ask you to perform a task that is inherently unsafe or that you are not adequately trained to perform. When we do ask for your assistance with any job we expect an enthusiastic and cooperative response.

## GENERAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Ensures the communication and selling of the Ski/Snowboard School products, to the public along with the Director and communication with Guest Services.
Operates the department in line with departmental standards, guidelines, objectives and operation. Work with the Manager for weekly and monthly expenses for operations to follow the Ski/Snowboard School budget plan, to meet or exceed financial goals.
Maintains and enhances the guest-focused culture in all areas of responsibility.
Assist in maintaining schedules of all Ski/Snowboard School employees, and communication in compliance with departmental objectives. Assist in accurate scheduling for all Instructor Staff and Supervisors. Monitor and ensure staff levels are accurate to meet reservation and lesson sales for each day and to project future sales.
Effective and appropriate communication skills in alignment with company culture with all levels of employees and guests.
Understanding of and compliance with corporate and resort-specific policies and procedures.

## ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITY

Demonstrate an ongoing commitment to delivering excellent customer service. This involves courteously interacting with guests and being able to answer questions professionally.
Assists with motivating, evaluating of staff to ensure adequate guidance and resources to accomplish established departmental goals and objectives. Tracking all employees received training, support, guidance, feedback and resources necessary.
Supports the Ski/Snowboard School Director, Manager and Supervisors to schedule adequate staff to meet both the changing ski/snowboard lesson demands and budget guidelines.
Assists Ski/Snowboard School Manager to maintain detailed, organized and accurate scheduling and payroll. Monitor and ensure staffing levels and schedules according to daily demand.
Assists Ski/Snowboard School Manager in scheduling instructors to daily lesson assignments and complete required daily documentation neatly and accurately ie; daily boards.
Assist in tracking instructors hours and producing accurate payroll for our biweekly payroll.
Assist with check-in for lessons during weekends and holidays.
Maintain records of instructor training with Supervisors and Trainers.
Manage the department risk management program, keep all risk documentation up to date in the YELLOW Safety Binder, including accurate and updated documentation of training. Tracking all safety topics and line up safety meetings.
It is important to understand that the position of Ski/Snowboard School Admin does involve a considerable amount of planning and development for daily payroll. This is a non-skiing/riding position; however, walking on the snow at times will be required within the base area.
Job Qualifications Administration and Management Background
Prior supervisory experience required
Willingness to continually learn and update knowledge of skiing/snowboarding and instruction through PSIA/AASI organization.
Knowledgeable of all Ski/Snowboard School Products, Rental and lift products.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and non-verbal.
Must be aware of the ski areas terrain and facilities.
Must follow a professional over-all appearance, be neatly groomed setting an example of the dress code standards of the Ski/Snowboard School and maintain ski/snowboard equipment in good condition.
Must follow all Safety and Risk guidelines provided in the Dodge Ridge Employee Handbook.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office, Excel and email systems.
Willingness to work during extreme weather conditions.
Good physical conditioning, including flexibility, strength, and endurance.
Heavy and awkward lifting up to 50lbs
Must possess a valid driver's license and meet the Motor Vehicle Record qualifications as outlined in the Fleet Safety Program.
Job Attitudes Provide a positive and helpful attitude towards all our guests and all Dodge Ridge employees.
Support the Company’s policies and procedures.
Support the harmony and goodwill of the Company.
Be an effective team leader and motivator for the department.
Work Schedules Weather conditions and the number of guests play a large role in the work scheduling of Dodge Ridge employees.
When conditions are normal, you may be expected to work 40 up to 48 hours per week, including weekends and holidays. During busy periods, you may be expected to work six (6) days a week.
You must arrange for transportation to work so that you arrive at your designated workstation at the scheduled time. Keep in mind that you will often be required to drive on hilly, snow packed and icy road surfaces.
It is imperative that all coordinators arrive to work on time. Holidays and special events may require longer hours.
Working Conditions At any time during the ski season, Dodge Ridge employees are often required to perform their tasks in high winds, heavy snowfalls, low visibility, rain, and extremely cold or warm temperatures.
Work is typically outside working directly with resort guests and other resort staff members. It can be noisy, cold, wet, or humid. You may be expected to work in high places and frequently you will work around moving objects.
Uniforms A professional appearance at Dodge Ridge is required. Please wear your name tag and uniform at all times during your scheduled shift. We will provide most of the uniform for you to do your job. However, you will be required to provide some items as part of your job, as listed below. The quality, color, and style of the items must be approved by your manager prior to being worn to work. All hats worn must have the Dodge Ridge logo while on shift.
Items You Must Provide if you Ski or Snowboard Ski / snowboard equipment and ski bindings that pass a binding function test (you should be aware you are responsible for any damage to your equipment while at work.
Goggles
Sunscreen
Gloves
All base layers (visible under, vest, jackets etc) Black only sweatshirt, NO hoodies and must be appropriate to the conditions.

# Receptionist

InnovAge

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4767527558281732918?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=258&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3278119976848157751&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description Job Description **Responsibilities** The **Receptionist** receives and properly directs all clients, vendors or other visitors to the InnovAge facility. Provides clerical, office and administrative duties in overall support to the InnovAge facility and function. Physical attendance at an InnovAge facility is essential to performing the job duties. Reception/Customer Service – 60% - Receives visitors and employees to InnovAge with a courteous attitude and disposition and assists individuals who need assistance with services and/or directions to offices. - Ensures facility security by maintaining sign in sheets and issuing visitor badges, notifies staff member of visitor’s arrival in a timely fashion. - Answers all incoming calls and routes to appropriate departments, takes messages and responds as needed - Maintains an orderly reception area in order to provide and maintain InnovAge image - Pages staff via paging system when appropriate and according to established procedure - Responds to emergency calls according to established procedures in a courteous and helpful manner. Clerical Administrative – 40% - Handles and processes incoming and outgoing packages and/or letters from FedEx, USPS, UPS and other postal delivery and messenger companies. - Prepares and processes interoffice and regular outgoing/incoming mail. Distributes mail in a timely manner with regard to confidentiality and sensitive issues. - Provides basic and general maintenance of all office equipment which includes pagers, copiers, faxes and printers, notifies appropriate parties when equipment is out of order - Maintains appropriate logs and records of office equipment and or supplies and assists with care and maintenance - Provides administrative support and performs general office duties as assigned. - Additional work functions and duties may be assigned REQUIRED - High School diploma or GED - Experience answering inbound phone calls and knowledge of multiline phone systems - Experience with standard office procedures including filing, record keeping and the use of standard office equipment such as personal computers, copiers and fax machines  PREFERRED - Medical Terminology - Bilingual - Spanish

$35.36 per hour

Montage Health

Welcome to Montage Health’s application process!
**Job Description:**
Under the leadership of the department office supervisor, the unit receptionist (UR) performs duties related to scheduling and pre-registration for upcoming services to assure a smooth process for the patient. Duties include reviewing orders from physicians and assuring therapy is scheduled accordingly; providing clear and accurate instructions/information to patients regarding upcoming appointments; verifying insurance type and assuring required authorizations are in place for worker’s compensation and state and county programs; entering complete and accurate data utilizing computer technology while ensuring existing data is accurate; and ensuring that therapist/physician schedules are as full and compactly scheduled as possible.

Experience
At least 1-year clerical experience in a fast-paced healthcare setting (scheduling, answering phones, typing, filing). Basic understanding of insurance requirements. Knowledge and experience with medical terminology.

Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel. Excellent communication skills. Ability to maintain a positive professional demeanor in a demanding environment. Excellent customer service skills. Ability to quickly comprehend new techniques and concepts and adapt readily to change.

Education
High school diploma, G.E.D., or equivalent work experience in related field.

Licensure/Certifications
Not applicable.

Equal opportunity employer.

**Assigned Work Hours:**
Various hours from 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday-Friday

- Ability to work and interact in a corporate environment
- Must be flexible and possess the ability to function in stressful situations
- Excellent time-management, communication, technical writing, presentation development, facilitation, and organizational skills required
- A dependable team player with business maturity, enthusiasm, and a positive attitude

# Certified Payroll Specialist

Myers and Sons Construction

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/888127787598610151?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6730002736102642343&crId=US_0US_0)

**Application Instructions**

Myers and Sons Construction is a Heavy Civil Construction Company. We specialize in Bridge Construction, Bridge Restoration, Roadway Rehabilitation, Water/Wastewater Treatment Plants, Concrete Bridge Overlays, Concrete Paving and Alternative Delivery Projects, including Design Build, CMGC, CMAR and Progressive Design Build throughout California and Colorado. For more information on our company please visit

**Position Description**

We are looking for a Certified Payroll Specialist. The position contributes to Myers & Sons success by performing various payroll and accounting functions relating to certified payroll, union costs, business licenses and job cost management. The ability to take ownership, complete a task with accuracy and communicate well is essential.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Weekly and monthly Certified Payroll/Labor Compliance (CPR)
- Approvals and tracking of Subcontractor CPRs submitted for projects.
- Communication with Owners/Subcontractors on CPR requirements and submissions for duration of prevailing wage jobs.
- DAS 140/DAS 142 filings
- Perform the weekly payroll cycle of union employees for Joint Venture Companies
- Backup for main company payroll for union and nonunion employees
- Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly submission of Federal and State taxes for JV payrolls
- Backup for main company submission of Federal and state taxes
- Ensuring compliance with all garnishment and support orders on JV Payrolls
- Respond promptly to payroll inquiries from employees and outside agencies.
- Creating and distributing various reports for management.

BENEFITS:

• Health Insurance (Medical/Dental/Vision)-our company covers 80% of the healthcare cost for our employees and their dependents. Employees are responsible for the remaining 20%, which is pre-taxable.

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)/Dependent Care FSA

• 401K with 8% Match

• Life insurance

• Voluntary insurance plans available-Accident/Critical Illness/Cancer/Hospital Indemnity/Life and AD&D

• Paid time off

• Professional development assistance

• Work in a collaborative environment that fosters creativity, support and mutual respect.

**Position Requirements**

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PREFERRED EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

- Prefer a minimum of 3 to 8 years Payroll experience, preferably related to the construction industry and prevailing wage.
- Prefer a minimum of 1 to 2 years of experience with Labor Compliance reporting, preferably related to the construction industry.

COMPUTER SKILLS

Proficient in Microsoft 365, Internet, MS Teams. Viewpoint/Vista, LCP Tracker, DIR upload experience preferred.

REQUIRED ATTRIBUTES

- Must possess excellent written and verbal communications skills.
- Must have professional customer service skills with the clients and subcontractors.
- Must prioritize in a fast-paced, multi-task environment with organization skills.
- Must have demonstrated ability to perform basic business mathematical functions.
- Must work with minimal supervision.
- Must effectively manage time and details.
- Must interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
- Must have organizational skills in handling & archiving technical data.
- Must comply with all operating policies, procedures, plans, and programs.

**Schedule:**

- 8-hour shift
- Fully on-site in our Sacramento Office (near Natomas)
- Monday to Friday

# Accounts Payable Specialist

Wine Industry Expo

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8575019020547152105?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5838612121174227993&crId=US_0US_0)

Pleasant Valley Farms - Farmington, CA
Full-Time \| Monday-Friday
Job Summary Pleasant Valley Farms seeks a dependable, organized, detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist to join our administrative team. This position manages day-to-day accounts payable functions, including processing vendor invoices, matching invoices to purchase orders and receiving documentation, reconciling vendor statements, preparing payments, maintaining accurate records, and resolving discrepancies. The ideal candidate is highly organized, accurate, comfortable working with numbers, and able to manage a high volume of invoices while meeting deadlines. This position works closely with vendors, management, purchasing, receiving, and other departments throughout the company.
Key Responsibilities Accounts Payable
Review, code, and enter vendor invoices accurately and timely.
Match invoices with purchase orders, receiving documents, and other supporting documentation.
Verify pricing, quantities, approvals, and payment terms before processing invoices.
Prepare and process weekly vendor payments, including checks, ACH payments, and other approved payment methods.
Maintain accurate accounts payable records and supporting documentation.
Monitor outstanding invoices and ensure payments are made according to established terms.
Reconcile vendor statements and research missing invoices, credits, or discrepancies.
Communicate directly with vendors regarding invoice and payment questions.
Research and resolve billing, pricing, receiving, and payment discrepancies.
Process vendor credits and ensure credits are properly applied.
Maintain vendor files and assist with new vendor setup and documentation.
Obtain and maintain required vendor information, including W-9 forms.
Assist with year-end vendor reporting and 1099 preparation.
Accounting & Administrative Support
Assist with account reconciliations and month-end closing activities.
Maintain organized electronic and physical accounting records.
Work with purchasing, receiving, operations, and management to resolve invoice discrepancies.
Assist with audits by providing requested invoices, payment records, and supporting documentation.
Monitor accounts payable aging and identify outstanding issues requiring follow-up.
Maintain confidentiality of company, vendor, and financial information.
Assist with additional accounting and administrative projects as needed.
Qualifications Previous accounts payable, bookkeeping, or accounting experience preferred .
Experience processing invoices and reconciling vendor statements.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
Comfortable working independently while also being part of a team.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general office software.
Experience with accounting or ERP software is preferred.
Ability to handle confidential financial information professionally.
High school diploma or equivalent required; accounting or business coursework is a plus.
Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in any of the following are especially encouraged to apply:
Accounts payable in agriculture, food manufacturing, processing, distribution, or transportation
High-volume invoice processing
Purchase order and three-way matching
Vendor statement reconciliation
ACH and check payment processing
Month-end accounting procedures
1099 preparation
ERP or accounting software
What We're Looking For We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and understands that accuracy and follow-through are critical in accounts payable. The successful candidate will be comfortable researching discrepancies, communicating with vendors and internal departments, and following an issue through to resolution. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced, established agricultural business and wants a stable, long-term position with a growing team.
Benefits Pleasant Valley Farms offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, which may include:
Competitive hourly pay
Full-time, year-round employment
Medical benefits
Paid time off
Paid holidays
Retirement benefits
Stable Monday-Friday schedule
Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility
About Pleasant Valley Farms For more than 60 years, Pleasant Valley Farms has produced high-quality eggs for Northern California consumers. Our operation includes egg production, processing, distribution, and transportation, creating a fast-paced environment where teamwork, accuracy, food safety, and quality are essential.
Pleasant Valley Farms is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable Associate to join our finance team. The ideal candidate has AR experience, strong communication skills, and thrives in a fast-paced consumer business environment.

Generate and send customer/partner invoices accurately and promptly, ensuring pricing, terms, and billing details are correct

Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, and Retail/Wholesale teams to resolve billing discrepancies quickly

Maintain accurate, up-to-date customer and partner records

Strong understanding of AR processes and general accounting principles

Proficient in accounting software (QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP) and Excel

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Proactive, able to resolve issues independently

Frontier Toyota
