Job Description
Job Title: Human Resource Specialist/ Payroll Clerk Generalist

Job Summary: This is a dual role position.

The Human Resource Generalist portion of this position will execute the daily functions of the Human Resource (HR) department including records & data keeping, hiring, interviewing staff, initiating training, administering pay, benefits, and leave, and enforcing company policies and practices as directed. As the Payroll Clerk Generalist, this position facilitates payroll, payroll taxes, compiles, and maintains payroll & benefits records & processes.

Human Resource Specialist

Duties/Responsibilities:

Reviews, tracks, and documents compliance with mandatory and non-mandatory training, continuing education, and work assessments. This may include safety training, anti-harassment training, professional licensure, and aptitude exams and certifications.

Recruits, interviews, and facilitates the hiring of qualified job applicants for open positions; collaborates with departmental managers to understand skills and competencies required for openings.

Conducts or acquires background checks, employee eligibility verifications and other hiring processes. Maintains Employment Database.

Implements new hire orientation and employee recognition programs.

Performs routine tasks required to administer and execute human resource programs including but not limited to compensation, benefits, and leave; disciplinary matters; disputes and investigations; performance and talent management; productivity, recognition, and morale; occupational health and safety; and training and development.

Handles employment-related inquiries from applicants, employees, and supervisors, referring complex and/or sensitive matters to the appropriate staff.

Attends and participates in employee disciplinary meetings, terminations, and investigations as directed.

Maintains compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and recommended best practices; reviews policies and practices to maintain compliance. Processes garnishments.

Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law.

Manages ADP Workforce Payroll System & Wages

Ability to work overtime, as may be necessary for business operations

Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.

Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.

Thorough knowledge of employment-related laws and regulations.

Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organizations HRIS and talent management systems.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

At least four years of Human Resource management experience required.

At least two years Payroll processing experience required

SHRM-CP a plus.

ADP Workforce a plus

Payroll Clerk Generalist

Essential Duties

Compiles payroll data such as hours worked; sales volume, bonuses, and commissions; monies to be withheld for taxes; employee contributions to insurance and retirement plans; etc., from time sheets and other records.

Updates master payroll records by verifying and recording changes affecting net wages such as federal and state tax exemptions, insurance coverage, etc., and data concerning compensation increases, promotions and/or transfer of employees between departments.

Computes wages and deductions, reviews for accuracy and posts to payroll records.

Prepares and issues paychecks.

Keeps records of leave pay and nontaxable wages.

Prepares periodic reports of earnings, taxes, and deductions.

Manages all HR related functions: Hiring, investigations, separations, training, documents, etc.

Prepares/files all hiring and termination paperwork including COBRA letters.

Maintains employment database & records

PrideStaff East Sacramento

### Job Description

Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable QuickBooks Specialist / Bookkeeper for a growing business in Sacramento, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining the daily financial operations, managing accounts payable and receivable, and performing regular reconciliations. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks, a firm grasp of foundational accounting principles, and excellent organizational skills to keep the financial records accurate and up to date.

Key Responsibilities

- Accounts Payable and Receivable: Process incoming invoices, handle vendor payments, prepare client billing, and track outstanding receivables to ensure timely collections.
- Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Perform regular reconciliations of bank statements and credit card accounts to maintain accurate balances.
- Financial Recordkeeping: Record daily financial transactions, categorize expenses, and ensure ledger accuracy within QuickBooks.
- Payroll & Journal Entries: Assist with processing payroll and preparing routine journal entries.
- Month-End Close & Reporting: Support the month-end closing process and assist in generating financial statements and management reports.
- Discrepancy Resolution: Research, track, and resolve any accounting discrepancies or ledger errors in a timely manner.
- Data Security & Compliance: Maintain strict confidentiality and ensure the security of all company and financial data.

Qualifications & Requirements

- Experience: 2+ years of professional bookkeeping or general accounting experience.
- Accounting Knowledge: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles (GAAP, double-entry bookkeeping, accrual vs. cash basis).
- Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Desktop (or QuickBooks Online) or equivalent accounting software.
- Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the broader Microsoft Office suite.
- Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in data entry and financial tracking.
- Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent written and verbal communication, and effective time management.

Preferred Qualifications _(Optional)_

- Certified QuickBooks ProAdvisor or Bookkeeping Certification (CPB/CB).

$32 - $38 per hour

Niagen Bioscience

About Niagen Bioscience
Niagen Bioscience (NASDAQ: NAGE) is a global bioscience company on a mission to redefine healthy aging. Our scientist's partner with leading universities and research institutions worldwide to discover, develop, and create solutions that positively impact human health and health-span.
Our flagship ingredient, Niagen® nicotinamide riboside, is an NAD+ precursor backed by 45+ peer-reviewed, published clinical studies, 300+ global research collaborations, and over 500 human studies supporting NR, with over 75% of published studies using Niagen. Niagen is also on track to receive a USP monograph, further solidifying its gold standard position in the NAD+ category.
Our brands include Tru Niagen®, a consumer supplement that safely and effectively increases NAD+, a vital cellular resource that supports healthy aging and cellular health, and Niagen™ Plus, our pharmaceutical-grade IV and injection products offered at wellness clinics nationwide and via healthcare practitioners. We are seeking smart, sharp, collaborative people to help us build the next frontier bioscience company dedicated to enabling wellness and well-being for every demographic. There's a better way to age.

Our C.H.E.
We enjoy working with like-minded people who embody “C.H.E.” and share our passion for health, wellness, discovery, and innovation. In our collaborative environment, employees quickly adapt to different situations, bringing:

Character – A positive attitude, commitment to success, and strong ethics.

Horsepower – Good judgment, creative problem-solving, and a strong work ethic.

Experience – Functional knowledge and skills to perform efficiently.

If you're eager to work with incredible people and contribute to something meaningful, join our team and help shape the future of bioscience on a global scale!

About the Role:
The Marketing Project Coordinator will support our creative and marketing teams in driving projects from intake through final delivery. This role will partner closely with the Marketing team, with a focus on E-commerce and Creative & Brand. This role sits at the intersection of creative execution and operational rigor, helping ensure cross-functional initiatives remain organized, stakeholders stay aligned, and deadlines remain on track in a fast-paced environment.

Working under the direction of the Marketing Operations Project Manager, the MarketingProject Coordinator will coordinate day-to-day project execution within established workflows, maintain visibility across project timelines and deliverables, and identify and elevate potential risks, competing priorities, or resource constraints as needed.

Core Expectations:

Coordinate creative and digital marketing initiatives from brief through final delivery , including seasonal campaigns, email and e-commerce assets, paid and organic social, direct mail, events, and special marketing initiatives.

Support the translation of high-level concepts and campaign goals into actionable project plans with defined scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and ownership.

Review incoming briefs for clarity, completeness, and feasibility , asking clarifying questions and identifying missing information before work begins.

Monitor and identify potential risks, bandwidth constraints, competing priorities, and timeline conflicts early in the process, escalating issues and supporting practical solutions to keep work on track.

Build and maintain detailed project timelines while coordinating day-to-day workflow across creative, marketing, production, and external partners.

Traffic projects through project management systems and maintain accurate project documentation, status updates, timelines, and next-step visibility for stakeholders.

Coordinate and support cross-functional collaboration and maintain project visibility when priorities, timelines, or deliverables shift.

Coordinate the creative review and approval process , including preparing assets for presentation, coordinating stakeholder feedback, consolidating comments, tracking revisions, and ensuring timely sign-off.

Qualifications and Success Factors:

3+ years of experience in project coordination or project management within creative, digital marketing, brand marketing, e-commerce, agency, production, or a related environment.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field preferred highly preferred.

Working knowledge of creative production workflows across design, copy, paid media, email, web, and digital campaign execution.

Proficient experience with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Jira, or comparable systems , required.

Experience supporting and/or coordinating work within a digital asset management system (DAM); Bynder experience strongly preferred .

High attention to detail with strong organizational and critical-thinking skills.

Ability to review briefs thoughtfully, ask appropriate clarifying questions, and identify missing information before execution begins.

Ability to recognize potential blockers, timeline concerns, or competing priorities and elevate them appropriately.

Competencies & Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organization and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple projects, deliverables, and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong follow-through and accountability.

Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple teams and functions.

Solutions-oriented with the ability to remain organized and composed as priorities shift.

Developing knowledge of creative, digital marketing, and project management best practices.

These positions hold the program view of time. You'll review submitted schedules, keep the master schedule honest, and say what a slipped date is going to cost before money moves against it. We hire across construction scheduling, program-level master scheduling, and delay and time impact analysis, so real depth in one of those with working fluency in the rest is what we are after.

This post is for future roles and not for a specific opportunity that is available right now. We accept applications and conduct interviews in advance of upcoming hiring needs. When a candidate is selected, their profile is activated in our talent pool for this specialty area. **We notify our talent pool candidates first whenever we have a project need.**

**Responsibilities** may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Note: We are seeking candidates of various skill levels, and the following responsibilities represent the core of these roles. Scope and complexity increase with experience level.

- Build and maintain an integrated CPM schedule that could cover design through turnover, with logically linked activities, resource or cost loading, and clear coding for cost-control alignment.
- Collect field progress data, update status weekly or monthly, and produce look-aheads, variance reports, and earned-value forecasts.
- Run critical path and what-if analyses to test sequencing options, recovery plans, and alternative delivery scenarios.
- Integrate third-party interfaces, permitting, utility relocations, and long-lead procurement items, so the plan reflects all external dependencies.
- Generate concise narrative reports, Gantt charts, S-curves, and/or KPI dashboards for project managers, field teams, and executive stakeholders.
- Perform schedule-risk assessments, identify drivers, quantify exposure with tools such as Monte Carlo simulations, recommend contingencies, and track mitigation actions.
- Support change orders and claims by preparing Time Impact Analyses that tie delays to cost and contractual entitlement.
- Enforce schedule governance standards, maintain data integrity in scheduling tools, and mentor junior schedulers to raise overall planning maturity.

**Attributes**

- Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.
- Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.
- Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in engineering (civil, construction, structural, transportation, systems, or related engineering discipline).
- 5+ years of scheduling experience for large (>$500M), complex, heavy-civil infrastructure projects.
- Experience with full CPM baseline schedule development, resource or cost loading, progress updating, and variance analysis.
- Experience performing monthly schedule updates, critical path analysis, and variance analysis, and explaining the results in a written narrative.
- Proven ability to interpret project scope, drawings, and constraints and translate them into logic-driven and sequenced, resource-aware schedules.
- Proficiency with industry standard project, construction, and risk management software (e.g., Primavera P6, TILOS, MS Project, Primavera Risk, Acumen Fuse, etc.).
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Master's degree in engineering (civil, construction, structural, transportation, systems, or related engineering discipline).
- Active professional certifications such as PSP (AACE), PMI-SP, PMI-RMP, or PMP (PMI), and/or CCM (CMAA).
- Experience serving in an owner's rep capacity on a highway, bridge, transit, aviation, or water and wastewater package exceeding $100M in construction value.
- Experience maintaining an integrated master schedule across multiple contracts on a program exceeding $1B in total value.
- Experience preparing or evaluating time impact analyses and supporting delay claim, entitlement, or dispute resolution work.

# Operations Manager - DDLC Support

$71.3k - $154k

ASM Research, An Accenture Federal Services Company

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2667073909041168011?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-586089332220807125&crId=US_0US_0)

**Position Overview**

The Operations Manager - DDLC Support leads day-to-day delivery operations for DDLC task areas, ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across multiple workstreams and locations in alignment with client requirements and contract objectives. This role plans, directs, and coordinates operational activities, manages scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risks, and partners closely with IT, logistics, security, and other stakeholders to optimize processes and drive continuous improvement. The manager oversees a dispersed workforce and subcontractors, manages frequent procurement of materials and equipment, and ensures adherence to corporate policies, Federal contracting standards, and performance metrics across all assigned DDLC efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Lead day-to-day operations for DDLC task areas, ensuring services are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with contract, quality, and performance standards across multiple places of performance.

- Plan, direct, and coordinate project and program activities, including work planning, staffing, task assignments, and resource allocation to meet operational goals and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

- Oversee cost, schedule, and performance baselines for assigned DDLC work, including budget management, forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis to leadership and the client.

- Coordinate closely with IT, logistics, security, facilities, and other enabling teams to ensure infrastructure, tools, and support services are in place for seamless operations and continuous service improvement.

- Manage subcontractor performance, including onboarding, scope definition, deliverable tracking, quality oversight, and issue escalation and resolution as needed.

- Implement and champion standardized operational processes, documentation, and metrics that align with CMMI Level 3, Agile best practices, and the company's delivery operations and service management frameworks.

- Monitor operational risks and issues, lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and maintain risk, issue, and action logs for leadership and client visibility.

- Develop, maintain, and present operational reports and dashboards such as volume, throughput, SLA attainment, quality, and workforce utilization to internal leadership and external stakeholders.

- Provide people leadership to a dispersed team, including performance management, coaching, workforce planning, and fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

- Ensure compliance with corporate policies, information security requirements, and client-specific governance, including support for audits, inspections, and reviews.


**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

- At least 8 years of recent, relevant experience planning, directing, coordinating, and managing IT or operations projects/programs of similar scope and complexity, including multi-site or worldwide delivery with a dispersed workforce.

- Demonstrated experience managing cost, schedule, and performance for Federal government contracts or large enterprise programs, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting responsibilities.

- Proven experience managing subcontractors and vendor relationships, including contract compliance, delivery oversight, and issue resolution.

- Active Project Management Institute certification as either a Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across IT, logistics, security, and other functional areas to achieve operational outcomes.

- Candidates must possess a current secret security clearance and reside in the United States.


**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience leading operations in an enterprise or Federal environment that uses CMMI Level 3 processes and Agile/DevOps practices for IT and service delivery.

- Prior experience managing programs that include call center, telephony, cloud/IT infrastructure sustainment, cyber security, and/or software application sustainment workstreams.

- Familiarity with ITIL-aligned service management, workforce management, and performance measurement practices such as SLAs, KPIs, and OLAs within managed services or delivery operations.

- Experience working within or alongside large Federal contractors or shared-services delivery centers, including coordination across multiple contracts, tasks, and stakeholders.

- Advanced skills in developing and presenting operational metrics and executive-level briefings, including the use of standardized reports and dashboards to communicate performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.


**Compensation Ranges**

Compensation ranges for ASM Research positions vary depending on multiple factors; including but not limited to, location, skill set, level of education, certifications, client requirements, contract-specific affordability, government clearance and investigation level, and years of experience. The compensation displayed for this role is a general guideline based on these factors and is unique to each role. Monetary compensation is one component of ASM's overall compensation and benefits package for employees.

# Dispatcher

$32.24 - $42.99 per hour

University of California, Riverside

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5520351751438153883?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5138235536220087789&crId=US_0US_0)

Position Information Under close supervision of the Communications Supervisor, the Dispatcher will perform entry-level work in operating a 911 telephone system and a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system on an assigned shift in support of a 24‑hour, 7‑day‑per‑week operation at the UC Riverside Police Department. The Dispatcher is responsible for entering calls into CAD; managing and routing 9‑1‑1 and Police telephone calls, and prioritizing dispatched calls for service to ensure the safety of all field personnel. The Dispatcher is also responsible for operating and monitoring numerous radios on various frequencies; monitoring fire, robbery, and intrusion alarm systems; making inquiries and entries into computer check systems; disseminating information to the proper authority; and operating numerous computer systems with connections to local State and Federal Law enforcement systems. The full salary range for the Dispatcher is $32.24 - $42.99 per hour. However, the expected pay scale for this position is up to $36.54 per hour. We base salary offers on a variety of considerations, such as education, licensure and certifications, experience, and other business and organizational needs. Applicants must have current work authorization when accepting a UCR staff position. Currently, we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for staff. As a University employee, you will be required to comply with all applicable University policies and/or collective bargaining agreements, as may be amended from time to time. Federal, state, or local government directives may impose additional requirements.
Requirements Educational Requirements Degree: High School Diploma or GED equivalency
Required Degree: Recent completion of the POST Public Safety Dispatcher Course.
Preferred Experience: Three years experience in police/fire emergency service dispatching is highly desired. Involving a substantial amount of telephone contact with the public or other employees. Such experience must involve the responsibility to perform numerous tasks simultaneously or progressively responsible experience in a field requiring decision‑making ability and the exercise of judgment.
Experience Requirements Experience: Twelve months of non‑probationary experience as a Public Safety Dispatcher for a law enforcement agency or fire department.
Minimum Requirements Demonstrated ability handling difficult, sensitive and confidential situations tactfully; accessing and updating various indexes.
Demonstrated skill in correct English usage, spelling, punctuation, and grammar; rapid and accurate typing; and independently drafting and documenting correspondence pertaining to the operations, policies, and procedures of the functional area. Speak in a clear, concise, and well‑modulated voice.
Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under conditions of fluctuating workload, high call volume, interruptions and competing priorities and requirements; utilize excellent interpersonal skills while working as part of a team and collaborating with colleagues; maintain cooperative working relationships; model and promote the University's principles of community and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
Ability to learn operational characteristics of communications equipment and tools used in the area of emergency dispatch. Learn streets, buildings, boundaries, and districts which represent geographical areas of responsibility within the University.
Proficient in the use of computers and computer applications, i.e., word processing, computer aided dispatch systems and Internet applications.
Willing to work rotating shifts with changing days off in a 24‑hour/7 day operation.
The ability to learn policies and procedures of receiving, processing, and dispatching emergency calls.
Learn basic communication rules and regulations governing the operation of radio transmitting and receiving systems. Learn standard radio broadcasting and dispatch procedures and rules.
The ability to learn principles and procedures of record keeping including maintenance and security of communications reports.
Demonstrate the ability to work under pressure, exercise good judgement and make sound decisions in emergency situations.
Demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with an elicit information from upset and irate citizens.
Demonstrate the ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions. Apply knowledge and reasoning to make prompt and effective decisions quickly in both routine and non‑routine situations. Analyze situations carefully and adopt effective courses of action.
Receive requests for police, fire, or other emergency services over the phone, answer 9‑1‑1 calls, alternate emergency, and business calls. Monitor agency radio frequencies to be aware of incidents elsewhere that may affect operations.
Demonstrate the ability to maintain accurate logs of incoming service requests and action taken; enter, update, and retrieve information from the computer and teletype networks.
Additional Information In the Heart of Inland Southern California, UC Riverside is located on nearly 1,200 acres near Box Springs Mountain in Southern California; the park‑like campus provides convenient access to the vibrant and growing Inland region. The campus is a living laboratory for the exploration of issues critical to growing communities' air, water, energy, transportation, politics, the arts, history, and culture. UCR gives every student, faculty and staff member the resources to explore, engage, imagine and excel. UC Riverside is recognized as one of the most ethnically diverse research universities in the country boasting several key rankings of which we are extremely proud.
UC Riverside is proud to be ranked No. 12 among all U.S. universities, according to Money Magazine's 2020 rankings, and among the top 1 percent of universities worldwide, according to the 2019-20 Center for World University rankings.
UC Riverside is the top university in the United States for social mobility. - U.S. News 2020
UCR is a member of the University Innovation Alliance, the leading national coalition of public research universities committed to improving student success for low‑income, first‑generation, and students of color.
Among top‑tier universities, UC Riverside ranks No. 2 in financial aid. - Business Insider 2019
Ranked No. 2 in the world for research, UCR's Department of Entomology maintains one of the largest collections of insect specimens the nation. - Center for World University Rankings
UCR's distinguished faculty boasts 2 Nobel Laureates, and 13 members of the National Academies of Science and Medicine.

# Email Marketing Coordinator

$26 - $31 per hour

Ardmore Home Design, Inc.

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1978590802655501948?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2740142960615522944&crId=US_0US_0)

Description
About the company Ardmore Home Design (AHD), founded in 2008, is a privately owned, fast-paced, founder-led entrepreneurial company where we value people with strong skills to make our products and processes better every day. We design, sell, and distribute luxury home décor globally to interior designers and boutique/luxury retailers. The AHD family of wholesale brands includes Made Goods (flagship furniture made from unique materials), Pigeon & Poodle (home and bath accessories), Blue Pheasant (handcrafted tabletop products) and Burton James (luxury upholstered furniture).
About the Position The Email Marketing Coordinator supports the planning, execution, and optimization of email marketing campaigns across Ardmore Home Design's portfolio of luxury home brands. This role coordinates email campaigns from concepting topics through creative development, maintains campaign calendars, manages audience segmentation, and tracks and reports on campaign performance. The position also provides project coordination support for seasonal marketing initiatives, helping maintain timelines, organize assets and approvals, and keep cross-functional projects on track. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, comfortable managing multiple brands and priorities, and interested in using data and performance insights to continuously improve email marketing efforts. This individual embraces and supports our in-person/on-site work culture and embodies our company values of Ownership, Collaboration and Respect.
What you can do for us: Coordinate the development and execution of email marketing campaigns across AHD brands, ensuring campaigns are accurate, on brand, and delivered on schedule.
Maintain email and seasonal marketing calendars, timelines, task lists, and status updates to keep campaigns and supporting marketing initiatives organized and on track.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Development, Production, Marketing, Creative, Graphics, PR, Sales, and other internal teams to gather content, product information, imagery, and approvals.
Proofread and quality-check email content, links, images, product information, audience segments, and other campaign details prior to deployment.
Support audience segmentation and list management to help deliver relevant communications to the appropriate customer groups.
Track and report on email performance, including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, engagement, and other key metrics.
Identify trends and opportunities to improve email engagement, campaign performance, and the customer experience.
Support A/B testing of subject lines, content, creative, timing, and other campaign elements and help document learnings.
Assist with automated and triggered email programs, including campaign setup, testing, updates, and ongoing maintenance.
Support broader marketing projects by assisting with project planning, scheduling, and tracking across seasonal launches and following up on timelines, deliverables, creative assets, and approvals.
Assist with content and asset coordination for seasonal launches and marketing materials, including product selection, copy, imagery, product details, pricing, finishes, availability, and approvals.
Support proofing, revisions, and final approvals for email and other assigned marketing assets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment.
Communicate project updates, deadlines, and requests between internal teams and external partners, and maintain organized campaign files, project documentation, calendars, and status updates.
Provide general administrative and operational support to the Marketing team as needed.
What we can do for you: Play a pivotal role in our company’s transformation and growth
Align with a growing company that operates in the luxury market
Provide training and career development opportunities
Enjoy a high-paced and collaborative work environment
Eligible for up to a 6% employer 401(k) contribution following six months of employment
Take advantage of paid time off away from work, including scheduled company holidays
Participate in competitive benefits and incentivizing programs
Team building company sponsored events
Employee discount and bi-annual sample sale
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
1-3 years of experience in email marketing, digital marketing, marketing coordination, or a related role preferred.
Experience with an email marketing or marketing automation platform; experience building and deploying email campaigns strongly preferred.
Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
Exceptional attention to detail and strong proofreading skills.
Comfort working with data and campaign performance metrics, with the ability to identify trends and insights.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools (Monday.com preferred); experience with project management, e-commerce, CRM, or analytics tools is a plus.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
Physical Requirements: The physical demands described here are representative of those that are required by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; as well as reach with hands and arms.
The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 15 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
Ability to work in open environment with fluctuating temperatures and standard lighting.
Ability to work on computer and mobile phone for multiple hours; with frequent interruptions.
Required to use stairwells to attend meetings and engage with employees on multiple floors throughout building.

Other Considerations: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Reasonable accommodations may be made to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the role.

Compensation: Starting base pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

# Marketing Operations Assistant

$20 - $25 per hour

Chubby Media LLC

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7827329572378561918?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3251725034563945421&crId=US_0US_0)

This position is employed exclusively by Chubby Media. No employment relationship is established with any other affiliated or sister company.

About Chubby Media
Chubby Media is the in-house marketing division of Chubby Group, a multi-brand restaurant group that includes The X Pot, NIKU X, Chubby Cattle, Chubby Skewers, Wagyu Factory, and other high-end dining concepts. Our team handles creative strategy, content production, influencer collaborations, and brand storytelling across all Chubby Group locations in the U.S. and globally.

Position Overview
We are seeking an HR Marketing Operational Assistant who is detail-oriented, reliable, and a clear thinker. In this role, you will support the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) with data management, financial documentation, administrative coordination, and day-to-day operations, including assisting with recruiting. This is a great opportunity for someone who learns fast and takes ownership.

Employment Details

Hiring Entity: Chubby Media

Work Location: Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-Time/Part-Time

Pay Rate: $20–$25 per hour (based on experience and qualifications), subject to applicable federal, state, and local tax withholding. May transition to an annual salary based on performance and role needs.

Benefit Eligibility: Yes

Start Date: Upon onboarding completion. All required pre-employment notices and documents will be provided at or before the start date, as required by law.

Key Responsibilities

Organize, verify, and update business data, maintain spreadsheets, and prepare basic summary reports.

Organize invoices, receipts, and reimbursement documents, verify amounts and payment details, and follow up on approvals and payments.

Support the accounting team with basic bookkeeping documentation, expense categorization, and reconciliations.

Schedule meetings, manage calendars, take meeting notes, and follow up on action items.

Assist the recruiting lead with scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, and maintaining recruiting records.

Coordinate internal information and documents, and complete administrative and operational tasks assigned by the CMO.

Qualifications

Open to all majors. We value practical ability, quick learning, and a strong sense of responsibility.

Clear thinker and quick on your feet, able to understand the purpose behind tasks and proactively flag issues.

Strong with numbers and detail-oriented, able to accurately verify data, amounts, and documents.

Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for basic data organization, filtering, and summaries.

Strong communication and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and follow through.

High level of discretion with business data, financial information, and leadership matters.

Preferred Skills

Experience as an administrative assistant, executive assistant, in basic accounting, or in data support is preferred.

Strong communication skills in English and Mandarin are a plus.

Why Join Us

Growth Path: Opportunity to move to an annual salary based on performance.

Direct Exposure: Work closely with the CMO and see how marketing for a multi-brand restaurant group runs.

Dynamic Growth: Join one of the fastest-growing hospitality groups in the U.S.

Compliance Statement
Chubby Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with all federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination (including but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, and any other protected category under applicable law), wage and hour regulations, fair scheduling, and worker rights. For positions in California, we also comply with the California Fair Employment and Housing Act.

Applicants may request reasonable accommodations under the ADA or applicable state law during the hiring or employment process. For more information, please contact our HR department. This job description is intended to describe the general nature of the work and is not a comprehensive list of responsibilities, duties, or conditions. Employment is at-will and may be terminated at any time by either party, with or without cause or notice, unless otherwise agreed in writing and as permitted by applicable law. Nothing in this job description should be construed as creating a contract of employment.

Jobrapido

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3651700479235625471?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3178231083312633158&crId=US_0US_0)

Marketing Manager – Social Media & Lead Generation

Hit Zero Highlights \| Full-Time

We’re Looking for a Social Media Superstar!
Are you the kind of marketer who knows how to make people stop scrolling? Do you love creating engaging content, building brands, and turning social media attention into real business growth?

Hit Zero Highlights is an exciting new technology company revolutionizing how cheerleading and gymnastics gyms capture and share their athletes' biggest moments. Our innovative video capture system allows athletes to simply press a button after completing a “highlight” tumbling pass, instantly creating a professionally branded video highlight that is automatically texted to their parents. It's a game-changing experience for athletes, parents, and gym owners, providing instant feedback, unforgettable memories, and a powerful marketing tool for gyms.

The excitement around our technology has been incredible. In just our first month since launching, more than 100 cheerleading gyms have already expressed interest in bringing Hit Zero Highlights to their facilities. We're an early-stage company with tremendous growth potential, a proven level of initial market interest, and an ambitious vision to bring our technology to cheerleading and gymnastics facilities nationwide. We're looking for talented, creative, and driven people who want to get in on the ground floor and help build something big.

What You'll Do
Social Media & Content Creation
Own and grow our presence on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Create scroll-stopping content, including Reels, short-form videos, graphics, testimonials, and product demonstrations.
Develop creative campaigns that generate excitement and engagement among gym owners, coaches, and athletes.
Manage our social media content calendar, posting schedules, and community engagement.
Identify trends and creative opportunities to make our brand stand out.
Turn real athlete highlights and customer success stories into compelling marketing content.

Lead Generation & Growth Marketing
Develop and execute strategies to generate qualified leads from cheerleading and gymnastics gym owners nationwide.
Build and optimize lead generation campaigns across Meta, Google, and other relevant advertising platforms.
Create compelling landing pages, offers, and calls to action that convert visitors into prospects.
Test new marketing channels and strategies to expand our reach.
Track lead quality, cost per lead, conversion rates, and overall marketing performance.
Work closely with leadership to turn marketing opportunities into new customers.

Email Marketing & Automation
Build and manage email marketing campaigns targeting gym owners and decision-makers.
Develop automated email sequences that nurture leads and drive product demonstrations.
Create compelling email content, subject lines, and calls to action.
Segment audiences and personalize messaging to improve engagement and conversions.
Monitor open rates, click-through rates, and conversions to continuously improve results.

Brand Development & Marketing Strategy
Help establish Hit Zero Highlights as a must-have technology for cheerleading and gymnastics gyms.
Develop creative campaigns around product benefits, testimonials, and customer success stories.
Collaborate directly with company leadership on marketing strategy and growth initiatives.
Bring fresh ideas, experiment with new approaches, and take ownership of results.

Who We're Looking For:
We're not looking for someone who simply schedules posts and checks boxes.
We're looking for someone who lives and breathes marketing, understands what makes content go viral, and knows how to convert an audience into customers.

Our ideal candidate has:
Proven experience growing brands through social media.
Exceptional creativity and a strong eye for design, video, and storytelling.
Strong skills in Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, and short-form video content.
Hands-on experience with paid advertising and lead generation.
Experience building and managing effective email marketing campaigns.
Familiarity with tools such as Canva, CapCut, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and email marketing/CRM platforms.
A solid understanding of marketing analytics, conversion funnels, and campaign optimization.
Excellent writing and communication skills.
A self-starter mentality with the ability to take an idea and execute it independently.
A passion for growing an exciting brand from the ground up.

Experience marketing technology products, SaaS solutions, or B2B services is a plus. Knowledge of competitive cheerleading or gymnastics is helpful but not required.

What Success Looks Like:
You'll be measured by more than likes and followers.

Success means:
Increasing awareness of Hit Zero Highlights throughout the cheerleading and gymnastics industry.
Building an engaged social media audience.
Consistently generating qualified leads from gym owners.
Increasing product demonstration requests.
Developing effective email campaigns that convert prospects into customers.
Helping establish Hit Zero Highlights as a recognized national brand.

Why Join Hit Zero Highlights?
This is an opportunity to get in early with an exciting technology company that has significant growth potential. We offer a competitive salary and bonus opportunity.

You'll have the creative freedom to develop new ideas, build campaigns, experiment with strategies, and make a measurable impact on the company's success.
You'll work directly with entrepreneurial leadership that values initiative, creativity, speed, and results.

If you're a social media superstar who also understands the business side of marketing, we want to hear from you!

How to Apply
Send us your resume, examples of social media accounts or campaigns you've managed, and a brief explanation of why you'd be a great fit.

Bonus points: Show us a piece of content you've created that generated exceptional engagement or measurable business results.

# Office Manager

$28 - $35 per hour

Opsgroupsf

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6624345558267150560?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-956429676842300477&crId=US_0US_0)

Schedule Monday–Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–5:00 PM (may vary based on patient needs)

The Orofacial Pain Specialty Group (the OPS Group, for short) is a new specialty practice in San Francisco dedicated to providing thoughtful, comprehensive care to patients experiencing complex orofacial pain conditions—TMJ disorders, chronic headaches and migraines, sleep apnea, and related conditions that too often go misdiagnosed or dismissed elsewhere.

The practice is led by Dr. Benjamin Kruman, DDS DABOP, a board-certified orofacial pain specialist and Assistant Clinical Professor at UCSF School of Dentistry.

We're built around a simple idea: patients dealing with complex orofacial pain deserve private, unhurried, evidence-based care—especially the ones who haven't found relief anywhere else. That means real time for diagnosis, conservative treatment planning, and a practice that never feels rushed. The Office Manager sets that tone before a patient even sits down in the chair.

We're at the very beginning: a new office, a new team, and a lot still to build.

The Office Manager is the person who makes the practice run—the first voice a patient hears on the phone, the first face they see when they walk in, and the person keeping everything else on track behind the scenes.

Our practice is built on four values—compassion, communication, innovation, and education—and the Office Manager brings them to life before a patient ever sits down in the chair. Compassion means genuine warmth for people who are often anxious or in pain. Communication means being clear and responsive with both patients and the team. Innovation means helping us build better systems as a brand-new practice figures out how it wants to run. And education means constantly learning—new tools, new processes, better ways to take care of people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll move fluidly between greeting patients, managing the schedule, ordering supplies, coordinating vendors, and building the systems and processes the practice doesn't have yet because it's brand new. You'll work directly with Dr. Kruman and have real input into how the practice runs day to day—not just executing someone else's playbook, but helping write it.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership without waiting to be asked. You'll rarely be told exactly how to do something—you'll be trusted to figure it out, ask good questions when you need to, and follow through. If you notice something's off, you fix it or flag it. That instinct matters more to us than having every process memorized on day one.

Responsibilities
What You'll Do
Patient Experience & Front Desk

Welcome patients and create a warm, professional, comfortable experience from the moment they arrive.

Manage check-in/check-out and keep the front desk organized.

Schedule and coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and referrals in AthenaHealth.

Answer phones and respond to patient inquiries clearly and professionally across phone, email, and other channels.

Maintain a calm, welcoming environment for patients who may be dealing with pain, anxiety, or uncertainty—and protect their privacy and confidentiality at all times.

Office Operations & Practice Support

Own the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice—supplies, vendors, building management, maintenance, deliveries, and general facilities needs.

Maintain organized files, records, and documentation; support basic financial processes like invoices, payments, and expense tracking.

Serve as a trusted operational partner to Dr. Kruman—anticipate needs, coordinate his calendar, and solve problems before they become bigger ones.

Help implement new tools, systems, and processes as the practice grows, and look for ways to improve how things run.

Assist with onboarding new vendors, partners, and (eventually) team members.

Build relationships with patients, referring providers, vendors, and the local community—and represent the practice well while doing it.

Help plan and host occasional events for the practice, its partners, and its patients.

About you
Who You Are
You're warm, capable, organized, and proactive—the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next and takes it on without being asked twice.

Requirements

2–3+ years of experience in a role with real people-facing responsibility and operational ownership—healthcare, dental, hospitality, or another high-touch professional services environment

Front-desk, office administration, or practice coordination experience—or something close enough that the transition is short

Clear, warm communication, in writing and in person

Ability to hold multiple priorities at once without losing your calm

Follow-through—you do what you say you're going to do, every time

Comfortable learning new systems and technology—we'll provide guidance, tutorial videos, and coordinate with AthenaHealth's training resources to get you up to speed on our EHR/scheduling software

Available in-office 5 days/week, with occasional evening events

CPR certification required within 2 weeks of your start date—not needed to apply. OPS Group covers the full cost of certification and training.

Nice to Haves

Prior healthcare or dental industry experience

Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy practices

Why Join Us
This is a chance to get in early on a new specialty practice and actually shape how it runs—not step into a fully built machine. The systems, culture, and patient experience here are still being written, and you'll have real input into all of them. As the practice grows, so will your role.

If that sounds exciting rather than daunting, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation: $28–35/hour, depending on experience.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position. The practice provides legally required paid sick leave and other benefits and protections required under applicable California law. Additional benefits, if any, will be discussed during the hiring process.

Our process
What to expect
Step 1

A short conversation to learn about you and share more about the role.

Step 2

In-person interview with Dr. Kruman
A deeper, in-person conversation about the role, your experience, and the practice.

Step 3

Reference check
We follow up with your references.

Step 4

Offer
If it's a match, we'll extend an offer and walk through next steps.

Step 5

Onboarding and CPR certification

# Bilingual Administrative Assistant (Spanish)

$21 - $25 per hour

Felton Institute.

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1242424083517571122?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6544994603211003593&crId=US_0US_0)

**Bilingual Administrative Assistant (Spanish)**

**CYFTAY Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program and Division Description**

Felton Institute has been providing comprehensive early care and education services in San Francisco since 1971. Felton now has four ECE programs in SF's Mission and Bayview neighborhoods; and offers a school-readiness program for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers--2 weeks to 6 years old. Felton's ECE programs include Infant/ Toddler classrooms and preschool classrooms, which serve approximately 400 children, full day/ year-round. These multicultural, educational programs provide a nurturing, developmentally challenging, and inclusive environment for very young children of low/moderate income families. We are committed to inclusive, positive environments that build on children's positive self-esteem and self-image.

**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Operations Supervisor, the Administrative Assistant serves as the primary front desk support for the CYFTAY Division. This entry-level role is responsible for providing excellent customer service to families, staff, visitors, and vendors by maintaining consistent front desk coverage and supporting day-to-day office operations.

The Administrative Assistant supports basic administrative functions, including answering phones, greeting visitors, processing mail, organizing records, and assisting the Operations team with routine tasks. This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, friendly, bilingual, and interested in gaining experience in administrative and nonprofit operations while working in a mission-driven, community-focused environment.

**Specific Responsibilities**

- Proven ability to maintain front desk coverage with a focus on creating a welcoming and safe environment for all visitors, demonstrating excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Provides Front Desk Administrative Functions, both on the phone and in person in a pleasant and professional manner at all times.
- Support the Operations Supervisor by processing procurement orders, reviewing order requests, researching pricing, coordinating purchases and placing orders through the organization accounts, record keeping of receipts.
- Track incoming orders and mail and assist with the daily distribution to ensure accurate delivery and accessibility for staff and departments.
- Supports with processing daily ROEs and invoices via processing system. Ensure compliance with procurement procedures, including vendor communication and recordkeeping for all purchase transactions, vendor quotes and documentation.
- Serves as program liaison back-up staff with visitors and vendors working at site including pest control and maintenance vendors. Makes recommendations regarding emergency procedures needed to maintain safety or security of the building including emergency pest control measures.
- Assist with meeting set-up, including ordering necessary supplies, arranging room reservations, and ensuring all logistics are managed effectively.
- Maintains an inventory and replenishes office equipment, furniture, supplies; equipment, appliances and maintenance suppliers; monitors warranty services, service agreements and secures servicing of equipment as needed.
- Supports Operations Supervisor setting up the logistics for the annual training to staff to meet program requirements, including CACFP.
- Ensures all CACFP files and records are collected, maintained, and organized including daily meal counts, daily attendance sheets, special meal accommodations/ milk substitutions (as needed), cycle menus, meal benefit application forms, and weekly infant meal records.
- Responsible for revising and printing new cycle menus two weeks before the 5th cycle menu ends and submits them to Head Cook for revision and approval.
- Supports to maintain accurate and up-to-date office files, records, and logs for assigned areas; develop, prepare, and monitor various CACFP files.
- Supports with submission of the CACFP Monthly meal reports by the 5th of every month to fiscal.
- Responsible for keeping the monthly CACFP Eligibility rosters up to date with changes for all EGE sites and supporting the operations
- Supervisor with the annual renewal process.
- Prepares communication to Admissions team of upcoming CACFP Meal Benefit Application forms that need to be renewed.
- Supports Operations Supervisor with the preparation of documentation needed for CACFP Program Reviews/ Audits
- Is trained as a backup to conduct CACFP site monitoring reviews.
- Works collaboratively with the Operations Supervisor to develop and deliver CACFP informational materials via presentations, handouts, e-newsletters, Remind app, and other forms of communication to staff and families.
- Prepare special reports and perform special projects that may require researching, gathering, and organizing information from a variety of sources; assist assigned staff with special projects as assigned; research information as requested.
- Participate in the collection, compilation, and analysis of information from various sources on a variety of specialized topics related to CACFP.
- Utilize various contemporary computer applications and software packages; develop, enter data, maintain, and generate reports from a database maintain, and utilize data to develop reports using spreadsheet software; create, format, and revise charts, graphs, flowcharts, worksheets, booklets, brochures, and forms using word processing and other software.
- Support with CA Department of Education CACFP programming, attends COE annual, interim, nutrition and other CACFP workshops.
- Completes other duties as assigned by the Program supervisor and Director.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

- High School Diploma or equivalent (required)
- 0-2 years of administrative, receptionist, customer service, or office support experience (preferred)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Basic computer skills, including email, word processing, and data entry; willingness to learn new systems
- Ability to provide friendly, professional customer service in a fast-paced, front desk environment
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to follow instructions, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines with supervision
- Professional demeanor, reliability, and ability to maintain confidentiality
- Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team with a welcoming and supportive attitude
- Ability to independently understand, speak, read, and write English sufficient to communicate effectively with children, families, staff, and visitor
- Knowledge of or interest in working with culturally diverse communities and low-income families preferredAt least 3-5 years of relevant work experience (Required)
- Excellent verbal, and written communication skills, basic math skills
- Ability to prioritize and perform multiple tasks, to read, analyze and interpret general business documents, invoices, forms, and governmental regulations.
- Professional appearance and demeanor, with professional ethics of confidentiality, ability to exercise good judgment and discretion.
- Attention to detail, ability to manage a wide variety of tasks and meet deadlines, and reliability/dependability)
- Reliable, ability to prioritize assignments and complete them in an efficient and timely manner according to due dates and timelines.
- Upon hire, must be able to pass a physical exam and TB screening, to meet Title 22 regulations as required.
- Upon hire, must pass a Department of Justice fingerprint clearance and a Child Abuse Index clearance as required by licensing.
- Must be able to lift up to 40+ lbs. (may include equipment)
- Must be able to bend, stoop, sit on the floor, lower, and raise self from floor and to use both hands to grasp securely on a consistent basis.
- Knowledge of low-income families and child development preferred.
- Knowledge of and sensitivity to the cultural background of the children and families being served.
- Ability to relate to children and adults in a positive, respectful manner.
- Ability to independently understand, speak, read, and write English adequate to communicate effectively with children, parents, staff and visitors.
- Ability to work independently under broad supervision.
- Ability to be a team player with a welcoming attitude.
- \*Bi-lingual in Spanish/English REQUIRED

**Additional Information:**

Reports to: Operations Supervisor

Job Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Onsite

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $21-25 per hour (DOE)

Benefits (subject to election and eligibility): Fully-Paid Medical and Dental Plans; Health Reimbursement Card, Paid Time Off (personal, vacation, and sick time), 403B with company match.

This position is union-represented by SEIU Local 1021 and is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

### Job Description

Job Description

Best Pest Service, Inc. is seeking a dependable, organized, and professional Administrative Assistant to support our daily office operations. We are a well-established pest control company serving residential and commercial properties throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with customers and property managers, and capable of managing multiple administrative responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

- Answer and return telephone calls, emails, and customer inquiries.
- Schedule inspections, treatments, follow-up visits, and recurring pest control services.
- Coordinate property access with tenants, property managers, and service technicians.
- Prepare and send proposals, contracts, inspection reports, service records, preparation sheets, disclosures, and other customer documents.
- Create and process invoices, payments, account statements, and service records.
- Follow up on outstanding invoices and assist with account reconciliation.
- Maintain accurate customer, property, scheduling, and billing information.
- Upload invoices and documents to customer and vendor payment portals.
- Assist with certificates of insurance, vendor compliance requests, and account documentation.
- Communicate scheduling changes and service requirements to customers and technicians.
- Organize electronic and paper records.
- Perform general administrative and office duties as needed.

Qualifications

- Previous administrative or office experience is preferred.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently.
- Professional and courteous when communicating with customers.
- Proficiency with email, Microsoft Word, spreadsheets, calendars, invoicing systems, and online vendor portals.
- Ability to maintain confidential customer and company information.
- Reliable attendance and punctuality are required.
- Experience in pest control, property management, the service industry, or accounts receivable is helpful but not required.

Work Arrangement

This is an in-office position located in South San Francisco.

Schedule

Monday through Friday. The position will begin part time, with the possibility of becoming full time based on workload, performance, and demonstrated skills.

Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview.

Compensation

Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications.

# Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant

$26.25 - $28.25 per hour

One Medical

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/584987331769391315?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4208232485582052029&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant

As a Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant at one of our offices, you'll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

- Use impeccable C-I-CARE in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary
- Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location
- Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs
- Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization
- Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting
- All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc
- Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.
- Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization
- Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you'll need:

- At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment
- An active phlebotomy certification to practice in CA
- Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A High School Diploma or equivalent
- Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously
- Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)
- A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care
- A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The range for this role is $26.25 to $28.25 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit

This is a full time role (40 hrs/week) with 8 hr shifts generally taking place between 8:00 am and 6:00 pm Monday-Friday in San Francisco.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness. All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

- Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

- Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues
- Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
- Pre-Tax commuter benefits

Protecting your future for you and your family

- 401K match

- Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive:

**The Role**

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the Office Director and Principal, providing strategic and administrative support in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role is central to keeping operations running smoothly, acting as a liaison across leadership, and ensuring priorities are executed with precision and professionalism.

**Responsibilities**

- Serve as a primary partner to senior leadership, managing complex calendars, priorities, and day-to-day operations
- Coordinate meetings, travel, communications, and materials (presentations, reports, and correspondence)

- Handle confidential information with discretion while proactively anticipating needs and solving problems
- Support special projects, outreach efforts, and executive initiatives with strong organization and follow-through

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree with 5+ years supporting senior executives in a high-level administrative role
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines
- A proactive, collaborative mindset with strong judgment and attention to detail
- Flexibility and commitment to excellence, including availability outside standard business hours when needed

**Compensation**

The rate for this position generally is $35 - $45 hourly. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the California Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful California applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in California or perform the position from California. Similar positions located outside of California will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by California Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employee already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

**Benefits**

Depending on your employment status, benefits may include:

- Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability and other voluntary benefits
- Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Childcare

# Executive Assistant

$160k - $180k

Truex Métier

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7153841485313495129?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1422610033706309575&crId=US_0US_0)

We’re partnering with a leading venture capital firm to find an EA who can keep pace with investors backing the next generation of technology companies.
You’ll work closely with a senior investor, with lighter support for a second investment team member. The right person can read the room, think a few steps ahead, and keep things moving when priorities change. You know when to make the call, when to ask a question, and what needs attention before anyone flags it.
The Role Own a complex, constantly evolving calendar, balancing founder meetings, investment conversations, and internal priorities.
Handle travel end to end, with thoughtful planning around flights, hotels, dining, and the details that make a packed schedule work.
Stay ahead of shifting priorities, resolve conflicts, and close loops without repeated follow-up.
Build strong working relationships with founders, fellow EAs, and the broader investment team.
Coordinate occasional personal appointments and family logistics.
Be responsive when something urgent comes up, including occasional after-hours needs.
Who You Are An experienced EA with a background in venture capital, private equity, finance, or supporting startup leadership. VC experience is strongly preferred.
Comfortable working with people who move quickly and expect you to exercise your own judgment.
Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to reprioritize without losing track of what matters.
Resourceful, direct, discreet, and dependable. You take ownership and bring solutions.
Quick to learn new tools and find better ways to get things done.
Someone who enjoys building a close working partnership and learning how an investor thinks, works, and spends their time.
The Details Onboarding: Begin with a narrower scope and build toward primary executive support as the partnership develops.
Compensation: $160,000–$180,000, plus bonus; flexibility for an exceptional candidate.
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits and carry participation.
This is an exciting opportunity for a dedicated Executive Assistant to work alongside leading venture capital investors, support the founders shaping tomorrow’s technology landscape, and play a key role in a fast-paced, high-impact investment environment.

Scratch
