## Executive Assistant

Scratch's mission is to build a repayment platform to change the way consumers experience debt. We wanted to reinvent the loan servicing industry, wellfrom scratch. We wanted to create a world where debt plays a healthier and less taxing role in more people's lives. Our team is rapidly growing and comes from diverse backgrounds including Dropbox, Pinterest, Prosper, Bloomberg and Ripple. Our office is based in San Francisco. With a rapidly growing community of lenders and borrowers, we think it's time the world knows there's a better way to pay back their loans. We'd love for you to join in our mission and help play a role in changing the way we experience debt for the better! Our team is highly collaborative and works from our SF office 3 days per week - please note that this role requires a hybrid work model.

### About the Role

We're looking for an enthusiastic, organized and analytical executive assistant to join our growing team. In this role, you'll have the unique opportunity to work closely with our CEO and ensure he is set up for success each day. You'll anticipate the needs of our CEO, helping him to stay focused and proactively manage his schedule, workflow and priorities. You'll possess the strong business judgment and communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions. From keeping our leadership team organized to interacting with key stakeholders, the support you will provide will be critical to our company's continued growth and success. You will:

- Manage our CEO's calendar, and plan and schedule his meetings and appointments
- Anticipate and maintain our CEO's workflow and proactively manage his day to day activities and priorities
- Partner with our CEO and the Chief of Staff to drive leadership operations within Scratch, including drafting agendas for leadership meetings, taking notes and managing follow ups (communication, action items, and execution)
- Correspond and coordinate with internal and external parties (including customers, investors and other key stakeholders), including drafting emails and other written correspondence on our CEO's behalf
- Book and manage travel arrangements and reservations for the CEO and other leadership team members
- Assist on the CEO's special projects

### You May Be A Good Fit If:

\- You have 5+ years of experience as an executive assistant (start-up experience is highly desirable)

\- You're self-directed, take initiative and are proactive with excellent time management and prioritization skills

\- You have strong organizational, analytical, and problem solving skills and attention to detail

\- You're an exceptional written and verbal communicator

\- You have a strong awareness of maintaining confidentiality and discretion

\- You have an enthusiastic can-do attitude and excitement about being part of a mission-driven organization in a fast-moving and highly collaborative work environment

\- You have Google Workspace experience

### Benefits We Provide:

\- Health insurance: We cover 99% of your healthcare premiums and 70% of your dependent's premiums and offer competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans.

\- Learning and development stipend: We offer a $1,500 per year stipend for your personal career development!

\- Wellness benefit: We're proud to provide employees a $100/month pre-tax credit towards any gym or fitness program.

\- Catered lunches and snacks: We have high-quality catered lunches every day and well-stocked kitchens.

\- Generous PTO (including your birthday!), sick leave, and parental leave

\- 401k program: We offer a 401k program!

\- Additional benefits: We offer each employee the opportunity to enroll in pre-tax benefits, such as commuter benefits and an FSA account.

Gap Inc. Corporate Headquarters

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6974792570180733907?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=714&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6450722642915252806&crId=US_0US_0)

Executive Assistant, Athleta
About the RoleAthleta is looking for a highly trusted, proactive Executive Assistant to support the CEO of Athleta and help enable the effectiveness of the brand leadership team. This role is a strategic partner who anticipates needs, connects dots, and keeps priorities moving in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. Working closely with the CEO, executive assistants, administrative assistant team and cross-functional leaders, this person will manage complex priorities and help ensure the CEO is prepared, informed, and focused on the work that matters most.
What You'll Do

- Serve as a trusted partner to the CEO, proactively managing priorities, commitments, and follow through with sound judgment and discretion.
- Own complex calendar management, meeting coordination, travel planning, and expense processing with exceptional judgment and attention to detail.
- Anticipate needs and determine which matters require CEO attention, resolving or routing other issues to the appropriate partners.
- Prepare for and support key meetings, including agendas, materials, logistics, and action item follow up.
- Build genuine, trusted relationships across Athleta and Gap Inc., partnering effectively with senior leaders, executive assistants, and key internal and external stakeholders.
- Serve as a key connector across the Athleta administrative team, sharing timely communication, aligning on priorities, and providing guidance and partnership that enables the team to work effectively with a One Team approach.
- Serve as an approachable and resourceful point of connection within the office, helping employees navigate day to day questions and connecting them with the right resources and partners.
- Support special projects from planning through execution, bringing organization, follow through, and flexibility as priorities evolve.
- Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
- Operate with a high degree of independence, initiative, and agility while balancing multiple high priority and time sensitive needs

Who You Are

- Previous experience supporting a CEO or other C-suite executive is strongly preferred.
- You are a proactive problem solver who thrives in a dynamic environment and can navigate ambiguity with calm, agility, and sound judgment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships at all levels.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
- Exceptional attention to detail, organization, time management, and follow-through; able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.
- A self-starter with a service mindset, strong business acumen, and a genuine interest in Athleta, our customer, and our mission.
- Typically requires 6+ years of related experience, including significant experience supporting senior executives.
- Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with periodic availability outside regular working hours when critical business needs arise

# Billing Coordinator

$90k - $105k

Latham & Watkins

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2637378675233954108?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-910213055701138766&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Latham & Watkins**

Latham & Watkins is one of the world's leading global law firms advising the businesses and institutions that drive the global economy. We are the market leaders in major financial and business centers around the world. Our investment in people, commitment to innovation, and focus on the future empower you to build an incredible career and thrive as an exceptional professional in a supportive culture. If you aspire to be the best, and work with the best, this is where you belong.

**About the Role**

The Coordinator - Revenue Operations is an integral part of Latham's Revenue Operations team. This role will be responsible for inventory management including coordinating the activities of the billing process, performing complex billing duties in efforts to meet monthly targets, and monitoring and tracking accounts receivable (A/R), while managing the complete billing and collections cycle for the inventory of a specified group of billing attorneys, ensuring compliance with the firm's best practices for processes, tasks, and timelines. This role will be located in either our San Francisco or Silicon Valley office. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

**Responsibilities & Qualifications**

Other key responsibilities include:

- Serving as a liaison among attorneys, attorney support, the Global Finance team, and clients, ensuring timely responses to both internal and external inquiries
- Preparing and analyzing complex client billing by meticulously reviewing, approving, and posting client invoices; ensuring all billing activities comply with firm policies, client guidelines, and rate agreements, maintaining a high level of accuracy and precision
- Generating and reviewing proformas from 3E, monitoring work-in-progress (WIP) fees and costs, flags balances to billing attorneys, and addressing WIP balances according to billing attorney instructions, in line with the "Gold Standard"
- Promoting best practice for matter maintenance to ensure the judicious conversion of WIP to cash, including the accurate opening and timely closure of matters, appropriate rate/discount and e-billing setups, proper bill frequency matter coding, prompt submission of time entries, and timely application of BOA balances

Job Description

**Part-Time Accounting Assistant**

_San Francisco (SoMa), Onsite · 16–20 hours/week · $25–$30/hour_

**Schedule:** Monday–Thursday, 8am–1pm, with some flexibility on start time

**Location:** 170 Clara Street, a short walk from BART, Muni, the Metreon and Moscone Center

JS Sullivan Development is hiring a Part-Time Accounting Assistant to support our accounting team and help with general office administration. It’s a hands-on role in real estate accounting with a consistent schedule, a small collaborative team, and room to grow.

**What you’ll do**

- Enter vendor invoices, route them for approval, and process payments

- Manage filing, mail, deliveries, and office supplies
- Support scheduling, document prep, and special projects

- QuickBooks experience (coursework or certification counts)
- Comfortable with Excel, Word, and Outlook
- Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable
- Clear, professional communicator
- Yardi experience is a plus
- Accounting or business students, recent grads, and experienced bookkeepers who want part-time hours are all encouraged to apply

**Pay & benefits**

$25–$30/hour, depending on experience. Paid sick, vacation, and holiday time.

$24 - $26 per hour

Ascend

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4267399070035522113?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=594&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2235867174529455532&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Ascend Talent Solutions Job Description -**

**Job Description** \- With excellent organizational skills, the primary responsibility of the Billing Specialist will be to assist the Accounting team to ensure the proper and accurate entry and coding of accounting related transactions, invoices, expense reports, and the timely submission of customer invoices and payments.  The successful Billing Specialist will be highly proficient in coding invoices to multiple cost centers conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system and excellent at applying payments accurately.  Strong internal and external facing communication skills is required to understand purchases, invoices and payments for proper allocation and reporting. Additional responsibilities for the Billing Specialist include the following:

**Responsibilities Include:**

- Prepare and send all customer billing
- Produce the monthly aging report
- Respond to customer billing inquiries, resend bills, and send collection emails
- Codes such items as invoices, vouchers, expense reports, check requests, etc. with correct codes conforming to standard procedures to ensure proper entry into the financial system
- Handles all vendor correspondence via phone or email
- Attaches the corresponding purchase orders to incoming invoices with all supporting documentation.
- Investigates and resolves problems associated with processing of invoices and purchase orders.
- Processes batch check runs, wire transfers, and ACH transactions.
- Assists with the processing of month end accruals for monthly financial reports, and monthly closings.

- Receives, researches and resolves a variety of routine internal and external inquiries concerning account status, including communicating the resolution of discrepancies to appropriate persons.

**Position Requirements**

- 1 - 2 years invoicing and accounts receivable experience

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills; must be detail oriented, ability to multi-task
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other financial systems.

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree preferred.

**Benefits**

- Medical, Dental, and Vision

**Compensations**

- $24 -$26/hr

# Business Operations Manager

$170k - $250k

Transluce

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4171436055761604226?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4443871734727602976&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Business Operations Manager

Salary range: $170,000 - $250,000/year depending on experience + comprehensive benefits.

Today's AI systems are difficult to understand — even experts struggle to predict behaviors like blackmail or sycophancy. And most analyses of AI systems are done behind closed doors, by the same labs deploying them. Society cannot rely on AI developers to grade their own homework. Transluce is a non-profit research lab building world-class tools to oversee AI and steer its development for the public good. We use AI to investigate AI, at a scale manual testing cannot reach, and we build in public so anyone can use what we make.

##### About the Role

Transluce is growing from 20 to 40+ employees in the next 12 months. We are looking for a Business Operations Manager to build the infrastructure that will let 40 people do their best work: how money moves, how we stay secure, how we choose our tools, and how the office works. This is not a role about keeping a machine running, but about building our operating system. This function is load-bearing. When operations are weak, people lose time to things that should just work. We have a solid operational foundation (e.g., Google Workspace, SOC 2, external accountants), but a lot of what works for 20 people will not work for 40+. Your role is to decide what gets built and in what order, so we get ahead of problems rather than repairing them. Strategy and execution are not separable here: the systems you design are the ones you run, and the judgment calls you make are informed by your hands-on experience. Because we are a small team, you may also flex into other operational domains, further expanding your skillset. This is an individual-contributor role reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will steward and mature our Business Operations function, directly advising the leadership team on key directional decision-making. We expect to continue expanding the operations team, and you would help define these roles.

##### You Are...

- Energized by building a whole domain and ready to be the core person accountable for its excellence
- Opinionated about finances, tooling, security, and office — and eager to apply and test those best practices in our specific context
- As invested in running a process well as in designing it
- Observant and relentless. You are unable to leave a broken process alone. You notice the friction and fix it
- Able to catch an accounting error while still thinking about what we need to build next quarter
- Trusted with money, access, and information that should not travel

##### Core Responsibilities

You will build our business operations infrastructure and drive its day-to-day execution including deciding where to automate, streamline, or outsource.

- **Financial Operations:**You are accountable for how money moves through Transluce: accurate, controlled and auditable, so spending is understood and predictable.
 - Direct our external accountants: give them the organizational context they need, review what they produce, and catch what they miss
 - Run the controls our fiscal policy requires (receipts on transactions, card statement reviews, spend approvals) and tighten them where they are weak
 - Own accounts payable and receivable, and process donations with clear donor communication, tracking and documentation
 - Ensure our annual financial audit is uneventful: clean books and evidence ready
- **Internal Tools and Security:**You give the team tools that make the work easier, and keep our security commitments while doing it
 - Administer our internal tool stack including Google Workspace and Slack; recommend new tools and retire what we've outgrown
 - Develop cybersecurity and privacy policies and ensure compliance alongside external firm and leadership
 - Maintain SOC 2 compliance by monitoring our compliance software, ensuring we maintain required controls, and coordinating with our auditors
- **Office Management:**You own the office as infrastructure: the physical environment that lets people do their best work. Our Executive Assistant runs day-to-day upkeep and events. You decide how the physical space should change as we grow
 - Fix what the space gets wrong and anticipate what 40+ people will need: sound insulation, call booths, etc.
 - Own our office IT (high-speed internet, room booking, A/V) so that nobody loses ten minutes of a meeting to a broken call
 - Maintain strong relationships with building management to address office issues promptly and effectively

##### Minimum Qualifications

- Reliable, self-directed, highly conscientious, and proactive operator who can manage the details of multiple workstreams and prioritize well
- Working knowledge of finance and accounting or ability to learn it fast
- Has managed external vendors to a defined standard, including pushing back on or replacing them when they underdeliver
- Technically fluent: can hold a substantive conversation with a security consultant or an IT vendor, and tell good work from bad
- Proficient with spreadsheets, accounting software, and financial management tools
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

##### Preferred Qualifications

- At least 4 years of professional experience in finance, consulting, business operations, IT, or similar. Ideally at growing startups or non-profits. Candidates with less overall experience or nontraditional backgrounds are encouraged to apply and may be considered for similar roles
- Has scaled operations at a similarly sized organization
- Can help with financial planning such as budgeting and cash flow projections. This is a bonus rather than a requirement.
- Already leverages AI and other productivity tools to work effectively or eager to learn. Deep technical skills not required.
- Well-connected in the AI research space

##### This Role Might Not Be For You If...

- You are happiest running a process someone else designed, and would rather not be the one deciding what to change
- You take pride in honoring every request and polishing every detail even when it's not the highest-leverage
- You want to set direction and hand the details to someone else,
- You would find chasing building management or fixing the A/V beneath you,

We work from our San Francisco office four days a week: our in-person culture is a big part of what makes Transluce special. We are open to sponsoring international visas for exceptional candidates.

- Queries & relays wants, warrants, drive and vehicle status, Be on the Lookout (BOL), and Attempt to Locate (ATL) information for law enforcement contact and investigations.

# Police Communications Dispatcher - Lateral (Continuous)

City of Oakland

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8977460226788398072?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8009531312710772131&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Police Communications Dispatcher

The City of Oakland is accepting applications to join the Oakland Police Department Communications Division. Come and join a wonderful team of professionals dedicated to serving the citizens of Oakland. Continue your dispatch career with the City of Oakland!

During training, working hours and days off vary. Dispatchers may work any of the three shifts in a 24-hour period; may be required to work a schedule with rotating days off; often work weekends, holidays, and overtime as required by emergencies or Departmental needs. This is a public contact position.

We are looking for someone who:

- possesses the ability to act promptly, logically, and decisively;
- can communicate clearly;
- is able to read, comprehend and retain information;
- will maintain a calm and professional demeanor even under stressful situations;
- has the ability to adapt to changing situations;
- is able to multi-task;
- is highly self-motivated; and
- will display a high level of integrity.

The sensitivity of the position calls for emotionally stable applicants. Applicants must have a satisfactory record as a law-abiding citizen. Final candidates will undergo a thorough background investigation, a polygraph examination, and a medical examination. Excessive alcohol usage, drug abuse, a poor work record or any falsification of employment information are grounds for disqualification from employment consideration.

What you will typically be responsible for:

- Receiving and screening telephone calls and recording data
- Analyzing calls for priority level
- Using computer-aided keyboard and data entry equipment or manually recording and relaying information (often of an emergency nature) to appropriate units
- Receiving, transmitting, and recording data
- Running queries in automated warrant information systems
- Answering questions from the public
- Dispatching from a mobile command center, as requested

A few reasons why you might love a career as a Police Communications Dispatcher:

- The work you do directly impacts the public and City of Oakland residents
- You will have the ability to demonstrate your honesty, moral and ethical decision-making skills
- In this role, you will use your fact-finding abilities to identify needs, make decisions, and address issues
- There are lots of opportunity for growth within the City of Oakland

A few challenges you may face as a Police Communications Dispatcher:

- You must remain calm to effectively handle high-stress situations
- This position requires that you are careful about details and thorough in completing tasks
- You will need to maintain composure when faced with callers in aggressive, angry, or emotional situations

Competencies Required:

- Analyzing & Interpreting Data : Drawing meaning and conclusions from quantitative or qualitative data
- Attention to Detail : Focusing on the details of work content, work steps, and final work products
- Customer Focus : Attending to the needs and expectations of customers
- Displaying Ownership and Accountability : Holding self and others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results
- Handling Stress : Maintaining emotional stability and self-control under pressure, challenge, or adversity
- Learning Agility : Seeking learning opportunities and applying the lessons to one's work
- Oral Communication : Engaging effectively in dialogue
- Professional Integrity & Ethics : Displaying honesty, adherence to principles, and personal accountability
- Professional & Technical Expertise : Applying technical subject matter to the job
- Professional Impact : Presenting self as a positive representative of the organization
- Teamwork : Collaborating with others to achieve shared goals
- Using Technology : Working with electronic hardware and software applications
- Writing : Communicating effectively in writing

This recruitment is open to experienced Police Dispatchers. If you do not possess previous Police Dispatcher experience, please apply at: Police Communications Dispatcher - Open (Continuous). If you are a current, SEIU-represented, permanent employee of the City and Port of Oakland with no previous Police Dispatcher experience, you may apply at: Police Communications Dispatcher - RESTRICTED (Continuous).

Minimum Requirements for Application:

Any combination of education and experience that is equivalent to the following minimum qualifications may be acceptable.

Education: Equivalent to graduation from high school

Experience: Three (3) years of full-time of responsible work experience as a Dispatcher in a law enforcement environment. Applicants shall not have had a break in service as a Dispatcher in a law enforcement environment greater than three years (36-months) prior to application.

Other Requirements:

- Applicants currently working in California as a Dispatcher in a law enforcement environment must possess a valid Public Safety Dispatcher's Basic Course Certificate issued the California P.O.S.T.
- Applicants currently working outside of California as a Dispatcher in a law enforcement environment must pass the P.O.S.T. Public Safety Dispatchers' Basic Course within one year of appointment as a condition of continued employment.
- Must be eighteen (18) years of age or older.
- Must pass a thorough background investigation.

Bilingual Requirements: A select number of positions filled through this recruitment will require selective bilingual skills in one or more of the following languages: Cantonese, Mandarin, or Spanish. Please note, identified bilingual skills will be tested prior to a final offer of employment. Candidates must pass the bilingual skills test to achieve placement on and/or remain on the bilingual skills eligible list. NOTE: Bilingual skills are not required for most positions.

Background Investigation, Psychological and Medical Assessment: Final candidates will undergo a thorough background investigation by the Oakland Police Department Backgrounds Unit which may include, but is not limited to:

- A thorough review of the completed Personal History Statement (PHS)
- A polygraph
- A criminal history check consisting of a fingerprint check with the California Department of Justice and FBI
- A drug history check (certain drug usage may result in an automatic disqualification)
- A credit history check
- Interviews with previous and past employers and co-workers
- Present and past neighborhood checks
- Education verification
- Driving record check
- Checks with Law Enforcement agencies in the area you live
- Military history (if applicable)

Unfavorable information revealed during the background investigation is grounds for rejection or discharge. After a conditional job offer is made, candidates will be assessed for compliance with Police Department medical and psychological standards. Any remaining background issues will be resolved during the post-offer phase. Character-related information discovered during the post-offer stage may be grounds for revocation of the conditional job offer and removal from hiring consideration. In addition, the City Physician will evaluate each candidate to determine their ability to meet the physical demands of the job. The medical exam includes a drug-screening test.

Supplemental Information:

This is a Continuous Recruitment, this recruitment may close without notice once a sufficient number of applications have been received. Candidates are only eligible to apply once every three (3) months. Candidates that earn their place on the resulting eligible list may remain active on the eligible list for up to two (2) years.

The Recruitment Process:

The City of Oakland works with a Civil Service system. Applicants apply online, and HR staff reviews their experience, education, and training listed on the application against the "minimum qualifications" listed for each position.

Candidates who demonstrate that they meet the minimum qualification requirements are then invited to participate in an assessment process (or testing) to measure their knowledge, skills, and abilities in job-related areas.

For this recruitment, all qualified applicants will be invited to participate in the online Police Communications Dispatcher Typing Assessment (weighted pass/fail): The typing assessment will consist of three, five-minute timed typing tests. The scores attained on the three typing assessments will be averaged to determine candidate's average net WPM. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to type at least 35 average net words per minute. Note

### Job Description

Job Description

Banner Uniform Co. is a locally owned San Francisco company that has outfitted Bay Area organizations since 2006. Our clients include local businesses and major public agencies such as **SFMTA, BART, the San Francisco Fire Department, and SFO** . We're hiring an organized, customer-focused **Sales & Account Coordinator** to help with managing existing accounts and growing the business.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. You'll work side by side with the owner, learn how a successful company runs, and see the direct results of your work.

**What You’ll Do**

- Help prepare quotes and assist customers by phone, email, and in person
- Follow up on quotes, orders, and customer requests
- Help keep customer orders and projects organized and on schedule
- Build and maintain positive customer relationships
- Assist with sales, marketing, purchasing, and other day-to-day business needs

**What We're Looking For**

•     **Customer-facing experience** in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or a similar role. Inside sales, account support, serving, hosting, and front-desk experience all count.

•     **Computer skills:** you're comfortable learning new software, and you know your way around Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

•     **Excel skills:** you work with spreadsheets and formulas, not just data entry.

•     **Strong communication:** you write and speak clearly and professionally in English with customers, prospects, and vendors.

•     **Organization and follow-through:** you're detail-oriented, can juggle multiple priorities, and get things done accurately and on time.

•     **Initiative:** you're self-motivated, resourceful, quick to learn, and comfortable owning your work with minimal supervision.

•     **Sales interest:** you enjoy building relationships and spotting opportunities to grow the business.

•     **Education:** coursework or training in business, marketing, sales, accounting, or a related field (high school, college, certifications, or professional development). **No college degree required.**

**Nice to Have**

Experience in promotional products, uniforms, branded apparel, advertising sales, B2B sales, or order/project coordination.

# Office Manager

$27.6 - $34.97 per hour

Cumming Management Group, Inc.

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5329902934954066972?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7257676870737250621&crId=US_0US_0)

At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!
Essential Duties & Responsibilities Trusted Support and Adviser: Provide invaluable support and guidance to the leadership team concerning all administrative needs, offering insight and assistance as the office pursues complex and exciting projects.
Project Support: Assist team members with various project-related tasks, including contract management, fee proposal drafting, report preparation, and presentation development. Conduct quality assurance and quality control checks as needed.
Office Maintenance: Oversee office maintenance and cleanliness, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment for all team members and visitors. Handle supply ordering and organization, manage incoming calls, and serve as the primary point of contact for office inquiries.
Meeting Coordination: Attend weekly department meetings, organize agendas, take detailed meeting minutes, and follow up on all actionable items to ensure alignment and progress on key initiatives.
Travel Coordination and Expense Reporting: Coordinate travel arrangements for team members, including booking flights, accommodations, and transportation. Assist in completing expense reports accurately and promptly.
Calendar Management: Maintain leadership calendars, scheduling appointments, meetings, and events with efficiency and attention to detail.
Data Management: Input and maintain accurate data in the company-wide CRM system, ensuring up-to-date and accurate information.
Business Development and Research: Support business development efforts by conducting research and providing insights into industry trends and opportunities.
Event Planning: Plan and organize office events, including Happy Hours, team-building activities, and Summer and Holiday parties. Coordinate Lunch and Learns and Birthday and Anniversary celebrations to foster a sense of community and camaraderie.
Culture Ambassador: Roll out company-wide initiatives and programs to enhance the organization's culture and promote employee engagement and well-being.
Onboarding Support: Work closely with HR to ensure new hires are onboarded correctly, providing guidance and support throughout the process to facilitate a smooth transition into the organization.
High-Level Support: Provide high-level support to office leaders, assisting in various administrative tasks, decision-making processes, and strategic initiatives as needed.
Additional Tasks: Performs other duties or responsibilities as assigned. Other duties as assigned.
Attendance at work during normal business hours.
Knowledge & Skills Required Administrative Expertise: Possess strong administrative skills with a deep understanding of office management procedures, including document management, scheduling, and record-keeping.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with team members, leadership, clients, and vendors.
Organizational Skills: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and ensure efficient office operations.
Problem-Solving Skills: Proven ability to identify issues, analyze problems, and implement effective solutions in a timely manner.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accuracy in all administrative tasks, documentation, and communications.
Time Management: Exceptional time management skills to handle competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain productivity.
Technology Proficiency: Proficiency in using office software applications such as Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and CRM systems. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software and technology tools.
Customer Service Orientation: Strong customer service skills with the ability to interact professionally and courteously with clients, vendors, and visitors.
Conflict Resolution: Ability to handle conflicts or difficult situations diplomatically and effectively, fostering positive relationships within the office environment.
Event Planning: Experience in planning and organizing office events, including social gatherings, team-building activities, and celebrations.
Cultural Awareness: Understanding of organizational culture and values, with the ability to embody and promote them as a cultural ambassador.
Business Acumen: Basic understanding of business principles and practices, including budgeting, expense management, and business development processes.
Flexibility and Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities, work independently, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Confidentiality: Discretion and integrity in handling sensitive information and maintaining confidentiality when necessary.
Team Collaboration: Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with Team Members across departments and levels of the organization.
HR Knowledge: Basic knowledge of human resources processes, including onboarding procedures, employee relations, and compliance requirements.
Proactive Mindset: Proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing proactive measures to enhance office efficiency and productivity.
Ability to lift up to 40 pounds.
Preferred Education and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in business administration, office management, or related field preferred. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
Experience: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in office administration, administrative support, or office management roles, preferably in a fast-paced related industry such as real estate, construction, or professional services.
Preferred Certification While not required, certification as a Certified Administrative Professional (CAP) or Certified Office Manager (COM) is preferred.
The salary range for this full-time role is $27.60-$34.97 per hour. Ranges are determined based on the position, geography, client and industry experience and level, and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range reflects base salary only, and not the total compensation package. Cumming Group reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, including client requirements.

Our project and cost-management services are specifically tailored to each client’s needs and add meaningful value at every step of a project’s development. Drawing on deep expertise in the communities and sectors we serve, we anticipate and solve problems, deliver solutions, and drive results. # Program Scheduler

$110k - $160k

K2 Space

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3896439047286507633?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5259401769693919713&crId=US_0US_0)

K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price - and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger - helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

**The Role**

**Can you bring order to chaos and keep programs on track when the stakes are sky-high?** We're looking for a Program Scheduler to architect and maintain end-to-end development timelines across diverse projects - from initial concept studies to on-orbit testing. You will operate across engineering, operations, and production teams to create detailed program plans and scalable solutions to drive execution for multiple programs. This role uniquely spans both government and commercial efforts, requiring a dynamic approach to planning across multiple priorities and stakeholders.

You'll collaborate with technical leads and program managers to track milestones, flag risks, and keep delivery aligned with aggressive schedules. This role demands both strategic insight and hands-on execution, coordinating non-recurring engineering, spacecraft builds, ground infrastructure, software development, and launch operations. If you're energized by solving complex scheduling puzzles and want to help shape the future of National Security and commercial space, this is your mission.

**Responsibilities**

- Own and drive master schedules for new satellite programs from inception through launch and on-orbit operations
- Develop, communicate, and deliver clear, data-driven critical path schedules and progress updates to internal teams and customers
- Collaborate with engineering, operations, and production teams to assure alignment to ground truth milestones
- Rapidly assess new and ongoing projects, identify required dependencies from internal and external stakeholders
- Gain deep operational insight into K2's engineering, manufacturing, and launch workflows to drive accurate schedules and process improvements
- Lead fast-paced, high impact reviews as needed to keep plans current and actionable
- Build schedule tools and reports to enable time-relevant decision-making
- Proactively monitor engineering data sources to enable more accurate schedules

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, finance, operations management, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience with project planning and integrated master scheduling
- Experience integrating schedules within the same tool, and from third parties and various data sources
- Experience with Smartsheet, MS Project, Primavera, and/or other similar-to schedule applications or processes

**Nice to have**

- Experience working in a fast-paced environment with cross-functional engineering and operations teams, familiarity with the engineering development life cycle
- Experience with first-of engineering projects and scaled production efforts
- Understanding of critical path analysis, schedules risk analysis, health metrics, and work breakdown structures
- Ability to support concurrent projects, executing with clear guidance and operating in ambiguity, connecting pieces of the puzzle and raising issues before they arise
- Experience with engineering development projects
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with extreme attention to detail
- Experience with summary schedule reporting tools such as Microsoft Timeline or equivalent
- Ability to set the appropriate cadence for updates, and pivot when necessary

**Additional Requirements**

- Active Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance preferred; willing to pursue and maintain a clearance if not already cleared
- Ability to work irregular business hours to support proposals or critical project timelines

**Compensation and Benefits**

- Base salary range for this role is $110,000 - $160,000 + equity in the company
- Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
- Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don't meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a "U.S. person" as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

For more than 75 years, the University of Southern California has been working to ensure that people of every age and from every circumstance can live life to the fullest. Throughout the decades, Trojans near and far have advanced the profession of occupational therapy and the research discipline of occupational science. Today, the USC Chan Division of Occupational Science and Occupational Therapy proudly carries this legacy forward as we aim to improve the quality of life of people and communities across the world.

We have a shared purpose here at USC Chan. Together, our researchers, educators, clinicians, students and alumni are dedicated to optimizing the engagement of people - especially those with disability, injury, illness, unhealthy lifestyles or chronic conditions - in the ordinary and extraordinary activities of life.

USC Chan Division of Occupational Science and Occupational Therapy is looking for a Clinical Client Scheduler to join the team! The Clinical Client Scheduler schedules client appointments according to availability of space, availability of medical personnel, provider availability, equipment needs, etc. Maintains daily, weekly and monthly client appointments. Communicates schedules to students, faculty, staff, or other medical facilities, as appropriate. Receives and screens client telephone calls and/or visits.

Schedules high volume client appointments according to availability of space, availability of medical personnel, provider availability, equipment needs, etc. Maintains daily, weekly and monthly client appointments. Communicates schedules to students, faculty, staff, or other medical facilities, as appropriate. Provides a high level of customer service for all clients.
